title: You Own the Scoreboard - Creative Strategist + Video Editor, Paid Per Winner ($500/mo + Up To $500 Per Winner)
description:
Before anything else: decode this and start your application with the result, in capital letters.



U0NPUkVCT0FSRA==



If that took you more than a minute, this role probably is not for you.



Now the real filter. Most people who answer video-editor ads want to be told what to make. I want the opposite person - someone who wants a scoreboard and the freedom to win on it.



Here is how this works. I hand you a product and the ads that already won for it. From there it is yours: you study the market, d
 the angle, write the script, generate the voiceover, generate or source the b-roll and AI UGC, and cut the ad yourself. I do not hand you concepts. I do not approve your shot list. You are the creative strategist and the editor in one person, and your ads either win or they do not - in the open, on a dashboard we both watch.



WHAT YOU OWN

- Read the market and the competitors, and pick the angle yourself

- Write the script and generate the AI voiceover (ElevenLabs or similar)

- Generate or source the b-roll and AI UGC (Veo, Seedance, Kling, Runway, HeyGen, plus stock)

- Cut it in CapCut for TikTok / Reels / Shorts - scroll-stopping first 3 seconds, built to convert

- Re-iterate our proven winners into new angles, and ship in volume, because winners come from testing many fast



THE SCOREBOARD - THIS IS THE POINT

- $500/month base. Deliberately low. It is the floor, not the goal.

- Every ad of yours that becomes a winner pays a bonus, up to $500 per winner, in tiers so you get paid as it climbs, not only at some number ads rarely reach:

  - 25% of the winner target -> $100

  - 50% -> another $
%, a full winner -> another $250 ($500 total for that one ad)

- "Winner" is defined per niche - each niche has its own target (conversions / cost per result / ROAS), and you are told the exact number before you start.

- Conversions attribute to your ads by name, on the same dashboard I use. You watch your own number climb and you know exactly what you have earned.



Nobody caps your month but you. Three winners is $1,500 in bonuses on top of base. That is the deal, and it is why I want someone who bets on themselves.



WHAT I NEED IN YOUR APPLICATION

Short, real answers.

1. Send a short-form video ad (yours or a competitor's) and tell me why it works and what you would test next. This is the answer I read first.

2. One ad you conceived and built yourself, start to finish - the angle, the script, the voice, the visuals. Numbers if you have them.

3. Handed a product cold, what is your process for finding a winning angle? Be specific.

4. Which AI video models do you use, and how many finished ads can you ship per week once ramped?



THE TEST - NOT OPTIONAL

title: Operations Manager
description:
Operations Manager — CCG Consulting



Location: Remote Employment Type: Full-Time Reports To: CEO / Founder



About CCG Consulting



CCG Consulting is a business funding advisory firm helping small business owners become funding-ready through credit building, banking relationship development, and capital access. Our team operates across three divisions — sales, credit repair, and funding — and we're growing fast. We're looking for an Operations Manager who can bring structure, consistency, and accountability to how we deliver for our clients every day.



About the Role



We're hiring a remote Operations Manager to own client service and fulfillment operations. You'll be the person who makes sure every client's journey — from onboarding through active service delivery — runs smoothly, on time, and to a high standard. You'll work closely with our sales, credit repair, and funding teams to keep case files, workflows, and communication tight, and you'll be the first line of accountability when something isn't moving the way it should.



This is a great fit for someone who's organized, doesn't let things fall through the cracks, and genuinely enjoys building and improving processes.



What You'll Do

Own the end-to-end client onboarding process, ensuring new clients are set up accurately and promptly across our systems

Manage day-to-day case and file management for clients moving through credit repair and funding services

Monitor service delivery timelines and proactively flag or resolve bottlenecks before they become client issues

Serve as a key point of contact for client service escalations, working cross-functionally with sales, credit repair, and funding staff to resolve them

Maintain and improve standard operating procedures (SOPs) for client fulfillment workflows

Track and report on key operational metrics (turnaround times, client satisfaction, case status) to leadership

Support the team's use of our CRM/automation platform (GoHighLevel) to keep client records and workflows accurate and up to date

Identify gaps or inefficiencies in current fulfillment processes and recommend practical fixes

Help train and onboard new team members on client service standards and procedures

What We're Looking For

2–5 years of experience in an operations management or client service leadership role, ideally within financial services, credit services, lending, or a fast-growing small business

Strong organizational skills with a track record of managing multiple workflows or client cases simultaneously without dropping the ball

Comfortable working in CRM or automation platforms (experience with GoHighLevel or similar tools is a plus)

Clear, professional communicator — both with clients and internal team members

A self-starter who can work independently in a fully remote environment

Problem-solver who takes ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do

Experience in credit repair, business funding, or financial services is a strong plus, but not required

Why CCG Consulting

Fully remote role with a flexible, high-trust culture

Direct impact — your work will shape how thousands of small business owners experience our services

Opportunity to grow with a company that's scaling quickly across multiple divisions

Work alongside a driven, entrepreneurial team that moves fast and values results

How to Apply



Interested candidates should submit a resume and a brief note on why you'd be a great fit for this role. To show us you read the full posting, please type "IMPACT" at the top of your resume — applications without it will not be considered.

title: 3D Artist / Visualizer (SketchUp + Photoshop)
description:
About Us 

We are a high-end, rapidly scaling U.S.-based interior design firm that works with luxury real estate developers, builders, agents, and discerning homebuyers. Our approach blends luxury design with practical, turnkey solutions, leveraging curated vendor partnerships and photo-realistic 3D visualization. We operate at the intersection of high-end design and data-driven operations to maximize our reach and impact.



Role Overview 

We're looking for a 3D Artist / Visualizer to turn our design concepts into stunning, presentation-ready images that showcase the full potential of each space. Speed and photorealistic quality are both essential here: you're creating the first impression of spaces that don't exist yet, and we want that first impression to genuinely delight the people who see it. You'll work closely with our 3D Artist team and our Design team, taking SketchUp models, concept mood boards, and real furniture specs, and turning them into final images that hold up against real product photography. Strong Photoshop finishing skills are essential to this role.



Key Responsibilities 

• Rendering and Visualization: Work from SketchUp scenes, set up lighting, materials, and cameras based on concept mood boards (lighting, ambience, colors, textures), and produce fast raw renders in Vantage or your render engine of choice. 

• Post-Production: Take raw renders to final 4K images in Photoshop: lighting and color balance, material realism, detail enhancement, and entourage, so every image reads as photography, not CG. 

• AI-Assisted Enhancement, With Control: Use current AI tools (upscaling, enhancement, generative edits) to reach realism fast, while keeping furniture, materials, and architecture true to the design. Catch and fix AI hallucinations before anything leaves your desk, and keep every view of the same space consistent. 

• Accuracy to Spec: Make sure furniture and finishes in the final images match the real products: proportions, fabrics, wood grain, metal finishes. Adjust or model pieces when needed. • Team Collaboration: Stay in sync with the 3D Artist team and Design team across concurrent projects, keep assets organized, and flag workflow improvements as you spot them.



What You Bring 

• Strong portfolio of photorealistic interior visualization, ideally with raw vs. final comparisons (please include portfolio link in your cover letter)

• Proven, hands-on skill across the workflow above: SketchUp, a render engine of your choice, and advanced Photoshop finishing 

• A real, current AI-assisted workflow, with a clear method for keeping output accurate 

• Highly organized, able to manage multiple concurrent projects independently 

• Bonus: experience with 3ds Max/Corona and/or furniture modeling from scratch to exact product spec 

• Enjoy being part of a team and align with our company core values



Company Core Values 

• RELATE: Humility, collaboration, and fun in everything we do 

• DISCOVER: Passion for innovation and continuous learning 

• DELIVER: Strong work ethic and personal accountability 

• DELIGHT: Commitment to exceptional client experiences



Minimum PC Requirements 

This is a remote role, and you'll work on your own computer. Our pipeline uses GPU real time ray tracing render engine and AI tools, so your setup needs to meet at least the following: 

• Operating System: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) 

• Graphics Card (most important): NVIDIA RTX GPU with at least 12 GB VRAM (e.g., RTX 3060 12GB). RTX 4070 or better preferred 

• Processor: Intel Core i7 (recent generation) or better 

• Memory (RAM): 32 GB minimum, 64 GB preferred 

• Storage: 1 TB SSD (NVMe preferred) 

• Monitor: Color-accurate display, 1440p or higher; calibrated to sRGB preferred 

• Internet: Stable connection of at least 50 Mbps, with a backup connection (e.g., mobile hotspot) 

• Power backup: UPS recommended, so work isn't lost during outages 

• Calls: Working webcam and headset/mic for team calls and screen-sharing

title: Media Buyer — Meta, Google & TikTok Ads (E-commerce / DTC)

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Proven media buying on Meta AND Google AND TikTok ads (show real e-commerce accounts you've run)

- Comfortable managing real ad budgets responsibly

- Reliable, communicative, and takes ownership of results

- Good written English and clear reporting



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with conversion tracking / pixel setup, GA4, and Google Tag Manager

- Familiarity with catalog / dynamic product ads and feed management

- Klaviyo /
 + SMS awareness (we're an
 & SMS agency at our core)



HOW PAY WORKS

Pay is based on experience and results. It starts with a short trial so we both know it's a fit, with a clear path to grow for someone who consistently hits targets. Tell me the rate you'd want (and how you'd prefer to be paid) when you apply.



HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY)

To apply, do all five:

1. Start your application with the word ROAS so I know you read the full post.

2. Send examples of E-COMMERCE ad accounts/campaigns you've personally managed, with real results (spend, ROAS or CPA — be specific). E-commerce results only.

3. Tell me which of the three platforms (Meta, Google, TikTok) you're strongest on, and be honest about any you're weaker on.

title: Credit Repair Specialist — CCG Consulting
description:

About CCG Consulting



CCG Consulting is a business funding advisory firm helping small business owners become funding-ready through credit building, banking relationship development, and capital access. Our team operates across three divisions — sales, credit repair, and funding — and we're growing fast. We're looking for an experienced Credit Dispute Specialist to join our credit repair division and drive real results for our clients.



About the Role



We're hiring a remote Credit Dispute Specialist to handle the hands-on work of analyzing client credit reports and executing the dispute process from start to finish. You'll be the one in the files every day — pulling reports, identifying inaccurate or unverifiable items, building dispute strategies, and pushing cases forward with the bureaus and furnishers until items are resolved. This is a seasoned role: we're looking for someone who already knows the dispute process cold and can manage a full caseload with minimal ramp-up.



What You'll Do

Pull and analyze client credit reports (IdentityIQ, SmartCredit) to identify inaccurate, outdated, or unverifiable items

Build and execute dispute strategies for each client, selecting the right dispute tactics and reasons for each item and bureau

Draft and submit dispute letters and follow-ups to the credit bureaus and data furnishers via DisputeFox

Track dispute rounds, response deadlines, and outcomes for each client file, escalating stalled or denied disputes appropriately

Review bureau and furnisher responses, determine next steps, and keep client files moving through each round

Maintain accurate, up-to-date case notes and dispute history in our CRM (GoHighLevel)

Flag patterns or escalations (e.g., repeated furnisher non-compliance) to the Operations Manager

Stay current on credit reporting regulations (FCRA) and dispute best practices

Support the preparation of client-facing credit progress updates

What We're Looking For

3+ years of hands-on experience as a credit dispute specialist / disputer in the credit repair industry

Deep working knowledge of the dispute process, credit bureau reporting (Equifax, Experian, TransUnion), and FCRA basics

Experience with dispute/CRM software (DisputeFox or similar) and credit report platforms (IdentityIQ, SmartCredit)

Sharp attention to detail — able to spot reporting errors and build a solid dispute case for each one

Strong written communication for dispute letters and case notes

Able to independently manage a full caseload in a fully remote environment

A results-driven mindset — genuinely invested in getting outcomes for clients, not just processing paperwork

Why CCG Consulting

Fully remote role with a flexible, high-trust culture

Direct impact — your work translates into real credit improvements for small business owners

Opportunity to grow with a company that's scaling quickly across multiple divisions

Work alongside a driven, entrepreneurial team that moves fast and values results

How to Apply



Interested candidates should submit a resume and a brief note on why you'd be a great fit for this role. To show us you read the full posting, please type "IMPACT" at the top of your resume — applications without it will not be considered.

title: GHL Builder + VA
description:
Are you in the Philippines and looking for a comfortable work-from-home job where you get paid to solve puzzles? This is for you.

We have an open position building and maintaining automations in GoHighLevel for our clients. You make your own schedule and work on your own projects independently.



Your job will be to build, test and fix the systems that make sure none of our clients' leads ever get missed. Workflows, appointment reminders, pipelines, and setting up new client accounts.



Some days you get a fun puzzle:

 • "The client wants a text to go out 20 minutes after someone books, but only if they haven't paid their deposit yet, and only during office hours." Nobody will tell you how to build that. You get to figure it out.

 • Taking a workflow that's working really well in one client's account and rebuilding it across six others

 • Working out why one single message in a sequence isn't sending



Other days you get the boring stuff:

 • Allocating shows

 • Rating lead calls

 • QA and testing

 • Replacing review screenshots

 • Renaming messy workflows so a normal human can understand them



Both parts matter equally.



Troubleshooting



The part that matters is what you do when something doesn't work.



Sometimes builds will fail, or we’ll set up the wrong workflows.



A message didn't send. A lead landed in the wrong pipeline. A sheet has rows in it that shouldn't be there.



Troubleshooting is the most important skill we are looking for.

 

Everyone makes mistakes. We're looking for someone who tests their own work, spots the problem, and says "this isn't right, I'm fixing it" as soon as they see it.



If you tend to build something and hand it over without testing it first, this job will not work out for either of us, no matter how good the building part is.



How we work together



You won't be figuring this out alone. I'll be in there with you, and the harder builds we'll work through together. Our goal is to develop your skills long term.



You need a problem solving instinct. At the same time, one of the most important problem solving skills is knowing when to ask for help, and asking early. We would much rather you say "I'm stuck on this, can we look at it together" after 30 minutes than quietly burn a whole day on it.



Nobody here gets judged for asking questions or for saying something looks wrong. Speaking up is the job and getting better is the goal.



What we're looking for



If you've got:

 • Some hands-on experience in GoHighLevel. You don't need to be an expert, but we don't want to teach the platform from zero, so you should already be comfortable working inside it

 • Experience troubleshooting worfkows. When something breaks you can narrow down where the problem is instead of changing things at random

 • The habit of testing your own build before you call it finished

 • A habit of figuring things out on your own before asking, and the sense to ask once you've hit a wall

 • Real patience for testing, checking and detail work

 • Attention to detail

 • A strong sense of written and spoken American English



We would love to pay a premium. Read on:



The details



Right now we're looking for a 30 hour per week position, which can expand to full time in the future.



That's roughly 6 hours per day. We'll discuss the exact schedule at your interview 

depending on what works for you. Because you're working on your own schedule and on your own projects, it's a fairly relaxed position.



We provide you with training, regular check-ins, and a small team that actually talks to each other. You will never feel "left alone" in this position.



Compensation



$900 per month (USD) for 30 hours per week.



Shortlisted applicants will be paid for a small test task before any offer is made. We don't ask anyone to work for free.



To apply



Please send a short Loom video (or similar screen recording) that includes all four of these:



 1. A short introduction of yourself

 2. Show us a workflow you have built in GoHighLevel and walk us through what it does



Answer this out loud:



"We have a Google Sheet where all leads from our different client subaccounts are sent. 2 duplicate rows are being created per submission for some locations. You want to troubleshoot this and make sure that 1 lead gets 1 row. What steps do you take?"



For question 3, please don't script or rehearse your answer. We want to hear how you actually think through a problem, including the parts where you're not sure yet. Reading a prepared answer off your screen is obvious and it tells us nothing.



Applications without a video will be disregarded.



Please keep it under 5 minutes. We care about how clearly you explain your thinking, not about production quality.



Skills required

 • Hands-on GoHighLevel experience

 • Enjoys problem solving and figuring out systems

 • Can troubleshoot methodically and test their own work before handing it over

 • Patience for QA, testing and repetitive checking work

 • Strong attention to detail

 • Comfortable asking questions and flagging problems early

 • Love learning: you're expected to learn our way of doing things

 • Excellent written English

Technical requirements

 • Internet connection of at least 20mb upload and 20mb download speed

 • Minimum of 8gb of RAM

 • A screen of at least 15 inches, or a second monitor. Building workflows on a small screen is genuinely painful

 • Able to record your screen (Loom or similar)

title: CUSTOMER SUPPORT ASSISTANT — SEVERAL BRANDS, EVERY DAY, LONG-TERM SEAT. WE ARE HIRING FOR JUDGMENT.
description:
Read this entire post before applying. If you skim it, you will fail the application in the first five seconds and we will both have wasted our time. That is not a threat — it's a favor. This job is not for most people, and I'd rather you find that out now.





WHAT THIS JOB ACTUALLY IS

We are a Swedish e-commerce company running several brands. Every brand gets customer
s every day, and every one of them needs a correct answer the same day. Forever.



Your job: clear the support inboxes every day. Different brands, different languages, the same questions over and over:



"Where is my delivery?"

Order not received.

Product not as expected.

Returns and exchanges.

General questions about the brand.



The
s are boring. The job is not. Here is what a normal day actually looks like:



Open the inboxes. Look each order up in Shopify. Find the tracking. Reply in the customer's language using DeepL, following our reply guide.

When tracking has been dead for a week, you do not tell the customer "please wait." You message our shipping agents in China, get an answer, and then tell the customer what is actually happening and when.

When a customer opens a dispute with their bank, you collect the evidence — order, tracking, delivery proof, your
 thread — and submit it to the payment provider. Before the deadline. Without being reminded.

When the same problem shows up three times in one week, you write it down and tell us. Once, with numbers.



The tools: Shopify admin,
, DeepL, the carriers' tracking pages, the payment provider's dispute portal, and a chat with our China agents. We teach you all of it in week one.





THE ONE THING THIS JOB IS REALLY ABOUT

We are in Sweden and we spend our days running ads. We are not going to sit next to you. If you message us "what should I do?" three times a day, this job has failed — for both of us.



The rule is simple. Before anything reaches us, you have already tried to solve it. When it still has to reach us, it arrives like this — four lines, nothing else:



The problem: Order 4471, tracking dead for 11 days, customer threatening a chargeback.

What I already did: Checked the carrier page, asked the China agent on Monday and again on Wednesday, no reply.

What I propose: Offer a replacement now, refund only if there is no scan by Friday.

What I need from you: A yes or a no.



That is the whole job in four lines. Anyone can answer "where is my order" when the tracking works. I am hiring the person who knows what to do when it doesn't — and who d
 first and asks second.



Quick question, and I mean it: a customer writes in Danish, and DeepL is down for the whole day. What do you do? Put your answer on the very last line of your application, after everything else. You'll see why below.





WHAT WE ACTUALLY CARE ABOUT, IN THIS EXACT ORDER

1. You show up. Every single day, Saturday and Sunday included. Not "most days." Not "I had internet problems." Every day.

2. The inbox is cleared inside your window, every day. Nothing sits for more than 24 hours without a reply.

3. You d
 first and ask second. Every time something reaches us, it comes with your proposed solution.

4. You stay. We are building a team, not renting an assistant for two months.

5. Your English and your tone are good enough — and get better.



Notice that skill is fifth on this list. That is not a mistake. We can teach you our brands, our reply guide, our shipping, our tone — we have a whole system for it, and the person who reads this carefully and types "lingon" as the first word of the subject line when applying is already showing me the exact trait I'm hiring for. It is not mentioned in the subject line structure below, but it is supposed to be the first word, then the structure. What we cannot teach is a person who opens the inbox every single day for the next two years, weekends included, and who would rather make a decision than wait for one.





HOURS — READ THIS PART HONESTLY

This is work on demand. There is no fixed shift and no fixed number of hours. The rule is simpler than that: the inbox is cleared every day, 7 days a week, inside 10:00–17:00 Swedish time. If you are in the Philippines, that window is 16:00–23:00 (17:00–00:00 in winter). You d
 when inside it. Some days that takes 30 minutes. Some days it takes 2 hours. Weekends are usually lighter. They are never optional.



You log the hours you actually work, and you are paid for them. Right now that is roughly 1–2 hours a day. More hours come with more brands and more tasks, on demand, not on a schedule. For the person who clears the inbox every single day, this grows towards 5–8 hours a day. That is a direction, not a promise, and I'd rather say so.



If you cannot open the inbox every single day, including weekends, do not apply. That is the entire job.





PAY — READ THIS PART SLOWLY

Hourly rate, paid twice a month, on time, every time. We have never missed a payment and we never will.



The rate ladder, in writing:



Start: $2.50 USD per hour.

After 1 month: $3.00 USD per hour.

After 3 months: $3.50 USD per hour.

After 6 months: $4.00 USD per hour.



Every step is automatic if you are still clearing the inbox every day. It goes into your agreement on day one. You will never have to ask me for a raise, and I will never "forget." The first raise comes after ONE month. Not six. Not "we'll see." One month.



On top of that:



$20 USD consistency bonus every month you open the inbox on every single day with zero missed days. This is the easiest money in the job, and it is entirely within your control.

$3 USD per Trustpilot review. Every 4- or 5-star review from a real customer that mentions you by name. Uncapped, and this is the real upside. A customer who was angry on Monday and names you in a 5-star review on Thursday is exactly the job, and you get paid for it every time it happens. Each review is matched to a real order before it is paid.



One line on that, because it matters: you never ask a customer for a rating, you never offer a customer anything for a review, and you never write one yourself. One fake, bought or nudged review and the seat is gone the same day. The reviews you get paid for are the ones you earned by fixing the problem so well that the customer wanted to say your name.



You are paid for the hours you actually work, not for counting
s. Some days the inbox is six
s and thirty minutes. Some days it is forty
s and a dispute deadline. Either way, the day is cleared.





WHAT COUNTS AS DONE

Every customer
 that arrived before 17:00 Swedish time is answered the same day, in the customer's language, following the reply guide, with the order looked up in Shopify. Every dispute is answered before its deadline. Anything that reaches us comes in the four-line format above. Not a taste judgment. If I send something back, I tell you exactly why in one sentence, and it counts once you fix it.





WHO SHOULD NOT APPLY

Please save us both the time. Do not apply if:



You cannot open the inbox every single day, Saturday and Sunday included.

Your internet is unreliable and you have no backup connection.

You have no plan for brownouts or power cuts.

You need someone to tell you what to do for each
.

You take angry customers personally, or argue with them.

You have never used Shopify admin. Not "seen it" — used it.

You want to negotiate the rate upward before you've proven a single month.

You are looking for a placeholder while you search for something better.

You want the "future tasks" at the bottom of this post to be the job now. They come after months of a cleared inbox, not before.



I'm not being harsh for fun. I'd rather describe the job exactly than lose a good person who wanted a different one.





HOW TO APPLY — THIS IS THE FIRST TEST

Ninety percent of applicants will get this wrong. That's the point.



1. Subject line, formatted EXACTLY like this:

| [most customer
s you have ever answered in ONE day] | [years using Shopify admin] | [hours/day you can work] | [days/week you can work] | [your download speed from speedtest.net]



Example: XXXXXX | 45 | 2 | 2 | 7 | 40mbps



Wrong format or a missing field — deleted unread. No exceptions, no second chances.



2. Your message must contain these eight things, in this order, and nothing else:



Line 1 — The most customer
s you have ever answered in a single day. For which store, and what kind of tickets. One or two real sentences. Generic answers are deleted.



Your setup — Computer and specs. Internet provider and speed. Backup internet. What you do when the power goes out. Be specific and boring. "I have good internet" is a failed answer.



Longevity — The longest you have ever stayed in one role or with one client. How long, and why it ended. Be honest. A short history with an honest reason beats an inflated one.



The reply — Reply to this customer in English, exactly as you would send it, maximum 120 words: "Hi, I ordered 12 days ago and nothing has arrived. Nobody answers. I want my money back." No order number was given, and you cannot find the customer by their
 address. Your reply is your portfolio.



The escalation — An order shipped from China 16 days ago. Tracking has said "in transit" for 9 days. The China agent has not answered for 48 hours. The customer says she will call her bank tomorrow. Write the message you would send me, in the four-line format from this post. Maximum 8 lines in total. If you write more than that, you have failed this part.



One honest answer — What would make you quit this job? Everyone has a breaking point. Tell me yours. I trust the person who names it far more than the person who says "nothing."



Shopify — The first thing you open in Shopify admin when a customer says the package hasn't arrived, and what you look at there.



Last line — The answer to the question I asked you earlier in this post. If it isn't there, you didn't read the post. If it is, I already know two things about you.



Do not attach a generic CV. It will not be read.





THE THREE STAGES

Stage 1 — The application above. Takes 25 minutes if you're serious. Most people won't do it.



Stage 2 — The inbox test. Unpaid. If your application is sharp, I send you five real customer
s (names removed) in three languages, our reply guide, and access to DeepL. You return five replies within 24 hours. One of the five has no answer in the guide. I am watching what you do with that one: guess, ask a smart question, or find it. I am not grading style. I am grading: did you follow the guide exactly, did you deliver on time, and did you d
 before you asked. This is a real preview of the daily job.



Stage 3 — Paid trial week on one brand's live inbox. Real customers, real China agents, real feedback. This is where the seat is won.





WHAT YOU GET IF YOU WIN IT

One company, several brands, the same people every day. You choose when you work inside the window. Pay on time, twice a month, without ever having to ask. A rate that grows on a schedule you can see, and hours that grow with the work. Someone who tells you exactly what's wrong in one sentence so you can fix it and get better fast.



And a real path. Once the inbox has been cleared every day for months, the next tasks are real: finding products, searching for ad videos, writing ad copy, product descriptions, talking to UGC creators and influencers. We train you for them. But that comes after, not instead.



And the upside has no ceiling: every customer who names you in a 4- or 5-star review is $3 in your pocket, forever, on top of everything above.



If you're the kind of person who is tired of clients who never answer, and who just wants a seat, a standard to hit, and to be paid reliably for hitting it — this is that.



Show me you can follow instructions, and show me you can d
. That's the whole first test.

title: Squarespace Web Designer/Developer + SEO & Digital Content Specialist
description:
Squarespace Web Designer/Developer + SEO & Digital Content Specialist



I’m looking for a highly capable, proactive person to help me manage and grow the digital presence of Wholeness Acupuncture & Integrative Medicine, a solo health and wellness practice based in Texas.



My work spans functional/integrative medicine, acupuncture, nervous-system health, somatic coaching, mind-body work, and personal growth. I want to create more educational content and expand my reach, particularly on the functional medicine side of my practice, without personally becoming responsible for website development, video editing, publishing, or digital production.



I’m looking for someone who can take ownership of that side of the business.



What you’ll be responsible for: 

Squarespace website design & development

You should be genuinely proficient in Squarespace. 

You’ll help me:

Build and redesign pages

Add new services and sections

Update branding, logos, images, copy, navigation, and site structure

Create pages that are visually beautiful, clear, modern, and cohesive

Make sure the site works well on desktop and mobile

Use custom CSS/code when appropriate

Troubleshoot Squarespace issues and integrations

Embed video and other media correctly

Identify website improvements I may not know to ask for



The website should help the right people find my work, understand what I offer, trust me, and take the next step. I also highly value aesthetics and brand alignment.



SEO & digital visibility



You’ll help improve the website’s search performance and overall digital discoverability, including:



On-page SEO

Local SEO

Google Search Console

Google Analytics

Google Business Profile

Page titles, meta descriptions, headings, internal links, and image optimization

Site structure and indexing

Basic technical SEO

Page performance where it can reasonably be improved within Squarespace

Structured data/schema where appropriate

Understanding and implementing current best practices for AI/AEO/GEO search visibility

Identifying useful content/search opportunities

You do not need to be an elite SEO strategist, but you should understand SEO well enough to competently maintain and improve an established small-business website and recognize when specialist help is warranted.



Video editing & content production



I plan to create educational video content regularly. I want to be able to record something and hand it off.

You should be comfortable:

Editing raw talking-head/educational videos

Cleaning audio and removing unnecessary sections

Preserving my voice and meaning

Preparing polished long-form YouTube videos

Creating thumbnails, titles, descriptions, captions, chapters, etc.

Uploading and scheduling through YouTube Studio

Finding strong sections of longer videos and turning them into YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels

Formatting content correctly for different platforms

Embedding relevant videos on my website

Helping repurpose useful content into website articles, FAQs, or other digital assets when appropriate

Because some of my content relates to health, accuracy matters. I want someone who knows when to ask rather than materially changing something I have said.



The way you work matters as much as your technical skills



I am a solo practitioner with many ideas and limited interest in managing digital production.

I’m specifically looking for someone who:

Takes ownership rather than waiting for detailed instructions

Notices what needs attention

Keeps track of projects and next steps

Anticipates what they need from me

Follows up when I am holding something up

Can batch questions and requests rather than sending me a constant stream of messages

Brings solutions and recommendations, not just problems

Has excellent follow-through

Communicates clearly and directly

Is highly reliable



Genuine emergencies, outages, and unexpected life events happen. What matters to me is having reasonable contingency plans, communicating proactively, and consistently following through on commitments.



I do not want someone who needs me to create and manage a detailed task list for them every day.



Ideal background



Strong candidates will have real experience with:

Squarespace website design/development

Excellent visual design and UX judgment

SEO and search visibility

Video editing, particularly educational or talking-head content

YouTube publishing and content repurposing

Working independently with a small-business owner or entrepreneur

Experience with health, wellness, coaching, or professional-service businesses is helpful but not required.



Work arrangement



Part-time and remote.

Approximately 5–10 hours/week to start, with the possibility of increasing hours over time.

Flexible schedule, although some reasonable communication overlap with U.S. Central Time is helpful.

Compensation: $7–$10 USD/hour depending on experience, skill level, and demonstrated ability.



This is intended to be a long-term working relationship with the right person.

Please apply only through the Google Form below:





Candidates who appear to be a strong fit may be invited to a short interview followed by a paid work trial using tasks similar to the actual role.

title: Senior Video Editor (Strong Marketing Fundamentals)

description:
START YOUR APPLICATION WITH THE WORDS "I OWN IT" IN CAPITAL LETTERS ON THE FIRST LINE. Anything else gets deleted unread.



Read this part slowly, because it is the whole job and most people should not apply.



I am not looking for a video editor. I am not going to write your scripts. I am not going to pick your b-roll, hand you a shot list, or tell you which hook to open on. If you need someone to tell you what to cut, this role will make you miserable and we will both know inside a week.



I am looking for one person who can take a product and hand me back winning short-form video ads, start to finish, without me in the room.



WHAT "START TO FINISH" MEANS

You own all of it:

- Research the competitors and the market, and come up with the angle yourself

- Write the script

- Generate the voiceover (AI - ElevenLabs or similar)

- Find or generate the b-roll and the AI UGC (Veo, Seedance, Kling, Runway, HeyGen, whatever you actually run) plus sourced footage

- Cut it in CapCut for TikTok / Reels / Shorts - hooks in the first 3 seconds, built to convert, not to look pretty

- Re-iterate the ads that already won for us - new hooks, new openings, new variants

- Do it in volume, because most ads fail and we find winners by testing a lot fast



I hand you the product and the ads that already worked. You go make money.



THE DEAL - LOW BASE, REAL UPSIDE

- $500/month base. That is the floor, and it is deliberately low.

- On top of that, every ad of yours that becomes a winner pays a bonus, up to $500 per winner, paid in tiers as it grows so you get paid on the way up - not only if it hits some giant number that ads rarely reach:

  - 25% of the winner target -> $100

  - 50% -> another $
%, a full winner -> another $250 (so $500 total for that one ad)

- What counts as a "winner" depends on the niche - each niche has its own target (conversions / cost per result / ROAS). You will always be told the exact target for whatever you are working on before you start.

- You see the same dashboard I see. Conversions are tracked to your ads by name. There is no guessing about whether you earned it - you can watch it climb.



So your base is small, but your ceiling is not something I set. A month where you land three winners is a very different month, and that is entirely up to you.



WHAT I NEED IN YOUR APPLICATION

Short answers are fine. Real answers are required.

1. Which AI video models did you generate with in the last 30 days, and what is each one good and bad at?

2. Walk me through ONE short-form ad you made from nothing - how you picked the angle, wrote it, voiced it, and sourced the visuals. If it had numbers (views, conversions, ROAS), give them.

3. When I hand you a product cold, what is your actual process for finding an angle that will work? Be specific - not "I research trends."

4. Once you are ramped, how many finished ads can you realistically turn around in a week?



If you cannot answer #1 and #3 from your own experience, this is not your role.



THE TEST - NOT OPTIONAL

Anyone writes a good application. I hire off the work, and this test is the job in miniature.



Brief: a $17 digital course that teaches complete beginners how to start a simple online side income.



Do the full loop yourself: pick an angle (look at how similar things are being sold right now), write the script, generate an AI voiceover, get your own b-roll / AI UGC, and cut ONE finished 9:16 short-form ad, 30 to 45 seconds. Then tell me two things: the angle you chose and why, and what time you started and finished.



Put it on Google Drive (set to "anyone with the link can view") and paste the link in your application.



No test video, no reply. Do the test, answer the four questions, and start your message with I OWN IT.

title: HR & Recruitment Coordinator
description:
# HR & Recruitment Assistant



**Excellent Spoken English Required | Remote | Long-Term**



TSG Behavioral Health & Community Services is looking for a reliable **HR & Recruitment Assistant** to help with interviewing, hiring, onboarding, and employee follow-up.



This position requires **very strong spoken and written English**. You will speak directly with U.S.-based job applicants, so you must be confident, professional, easy to understand, and comfortable leading conversations.



## Responsibilities



* Review resumes and applications

* Screen job applicants

* Conduct initial phone and video interviews

* Ask follow-up questions and identify potential concerns

* Document interview notes

* Recommend which applicants should move forward

* Schedule interviews

* Follow up with applicants

* Assist with job postings and recruiting

* Prepare onboarding documents

* Collect required employee paperwork

* Track new-hire onboarding

* Follow up with new employees

* Maintain organized HR and hiring records

* Assist leadership with general HR tasks



## Requirements



* **Excellent spoken English**

* Strong written English

* Confident speaking with U.S.-based applicants

* Professional and friendly communication style

* Strong listening skills

* Organized and dependable

* Comfortable conducting interviews

* Able to work independently

* Good judgment and attention to detail



Previous HR, recruitment, interviewing, customer service, call center, or administrative experience is preferred.



Experience working with a U.S. company is a plus.



## Schedule



Approximately **30 hours per week**



Must be available during **U.S. Eastern Time business hours**.



## Pay



**Starting Pay: $3.50 USD/hour**



This is a long-term position with the opportunity for increased responsibilities based on performance.



## How to Apply



Start your application with:



**TSG HR**



Please include:



1. Your resume

2. Your HR, recruiting, interviewing, or customer service experience

3. Your availability during U.S. Eastern Time

4. A **1–2 minute video introduction in English**



In your video, briefly answer:



* Tell us about yourself.

* What experience do you have interviewing or speaking with customers, applicants, or employees?

* Why would you be good at interviewing job applicants?



**Do not read directly from a script. We want to hear your natural English and communication style.**



Applicants selected to move forward will complete a short live interview and may be asked to conduct a **mock interview**.

title: Appointment Setter
description:
Appointment Setter – Remote

Full-Time | Monday–Friday | 9:00am–5:00pm UK Time



GROM Digital is a performance marketing agency working with aesthetic clinics, medical practices and treatment providers across the UK and Australia.



We are looking for an experienced Appointment Setter with proven GoHighLevel experience to join our team and take ownership of following up with inbound leads generated through our clients' advertising campaigns.



This is not cold calling.



The leads have already enquired about a treatment or service. Your job is to contact them quickly, understand what they are interested in, answer basic questions, follow up consistently and get qualified leads booked into the clinic's calendar.



Your Responsibilities

Call new inbound leads as quickly as possible

Follow up consistently with leads who don't answer

Communicate with leads through phone, WhatsApp and SMS

Book consultations and appointments directly into client calendars

Manage leads, conversations, notes and pipeline stages inside GoHighLevel

Use our existing dialler system to help work through calls efficiently

Keep all CRM information accurate and up to date

Re-engage older leads where appropriate

Handle multiple client accounts and organise your workload effectively

Communicate with the GROM team regarding lead quality, objections and booking issues

Requirements

You must:



Have previous GoHighLevel experience

Understand GHL conversations, opportunities, pipelines, calendars, notes and contact management

Have previous experience in appointment setting, telesales or lead conversion

Be confident speaking to leads on the phone

Speak and write excellent English

Be comfortable making a high volume of calls every day

Be organised and disciplined with follow-up

Be confident handling objections without sounding pushy

Have reliable internet, a computer and a quiet working environment

Be available consistently from 9:00am–5:00pm UK time, Monday–Friday

Please do not apply if you have never used GoHighLevel before.



Preferred Experience

Experience with any of the following would be an advantage:



Using a dialler or power dialler for high-volume calling

Aesthetic clinics or med spas

Healthcare or dental businesses

Managing multiple client accounts

Working inbound Meta or paid advertising leads

Previous dialler experience is preferred but not essential, as training on our current setup can be provided.



What Success Looks Like

We aren't looking for somebody who simply makes a few calls and waits for leads to reply.



We need someone who takes ownership of the pipeline.



That means:



New leads contacted quickly

Consistent calling throughout the working day

Multiple follow-up attempts made where necessary

No good opportunities forgotten

Calendars consistently filled with qualified appointments

Every interaction properly logged inside GoHighLevel

Clear notes and pipeline stages so the wider team always knows what is happening

Pay

$700 USD per month base salary + performance-based commission



There is significant opportunity to increase earnings through commissions based on performance and results.



How To Apply

When applying, please send:



A short introduction about yourself

Your previous appointment-setting or sales experience

Details of your GoHighLevel experience and how long you have used it

Whether you have previously used a dialler or power dialler

The industries and types of accounts you have previously worked with

A short voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you'd be good for this position

Applications without previous GoHighLevel experience or a voice recording will not be considered.



We are looking for someone reliable, proactive and results-driven who can become a long-term member of the GROM Digital team.

title: Senior Amazon Listing & A+ Content Designer — Premium Product Visuals
description:
# Senior Amazon Listing & A+ Content Designer — Premium Product Visuals



We’re an established home-care product brand looking for an experienced designer to create a complete new Amazon listing image set and coordinated Premium A+ Content.



Our benchmark is the visual quality and attention to detail associated with **Dyson and Apple**: refined art direction, realistic product imagery, clean typography and consistent execution—while maintaining our own brand identity.



**Please apply only if your portfolio demonstrates this level of quality. If you cannot confidently deliver exceptionally polished, professional work, please do not apply.** We are looking for a meticulously finished listing, with every detail carefully considered.



Product details, the current listing and our creative brief will be shared privately with shortlisted candidates.



## Project Goals



The new visuals should:



* Establish a distinctive premium identity and communicate brand authenticity, quality and trust.

* Explain the product’s benefits through compelling visual storytelling.

* Clearly communicate correct use, compatibility, maintenance and package contents.

* Set accurate expectations to help reduce confusion, returns and negative reviews.

* Maintain a cohesive look across the gallery, A+ Content and product variants.



## Anticipated Scope



* Approximately 8–9 Amazon listing images, including the main image.

* A coordinated set of Premium A+ Content modules.

* Dedicated desktop and mobile layouts where applicable.

* Adaptations for two product color variants.

* High-resolution exports and organized, editable source files.



We have brand materials, product references and a visual audit to share. The final scope will be agreed after reviewing these materials and your recommendations.



## Creative Direction and Required Skills



We’re looking for clean compositions, realistic materials, controlled lighting, natural shadows, sophisticated typography and convincing lifestyle scenes.



The work should combine the appropriate techniques for each image:



* Advanced Photoshop retouching and compositing.

* Accurate 3D rendering or professional integration of supplied renders.

* AI-assisted imagery combined with detailed manual editing.

* Consistent color grading and realistic visual effects.

* Clear, mobile-friendly infographics and A+ layouts.



**AI tools are welcome, but generated images must be professionally refined and checked.** Product proportions, logos, controls and materials must remain accurate. Hands, reflections, perspective and lighting must look natural, with no visible artifacts or inconsistencies.



You should understand Amazon’s image and content requirements and be comfortable working with approved, substantiated product claims.



We also value strong creative judgment. We want your input on concepts, layouts and storytelling, alongside excellent execution.



## How to Apply



Please include:



1. **3–5 of your strongest relevant projects**—premium product campaigns, complete Amazon image sets or A+ Content.

2. Live listing links or detailed case studies, where available.

3. Your exact contribution to each example: art direction, retouching, compositing, AI generation, 3D or layout.

4. A brief explanation of your workflow and quality-control process.

5. Your availability and typical turnaround for a comparable project.



Please prioritize relevant examples over a large, unrelated portfolio. Applications without relevant work samples will not be considered.



If you also create high-quality product animations or videos, include examples. This may become a separate follow-up project.



This is a **project-based engagement**, with potential for additional creative work following a successful collaboration.

title: Booking Agent
description:
Remote Medical Appointment Setter – Canadian Medical Clinic

Your primary responsibility will be communicating with patients and successfully booking them for medical procedures. You will work with multiple systems at the same time, including our **EMR (Electronic Medical Records) system and call platform**.



This is a **performance-driven position**, so please read the requirements and booking expectations carefully before applying.



## Compensation



**Starting Pay: $3.00 CAD/hour**



There are additional **weekly and monthly performance bonuses** based on qualified procedure bookings.



### Weekly Bonus



Complete **more than 30 qualified bookings per week** and earn an additional:



**$0.50 CAD per qualifying booking above 30**



For bonus purposes:



* Bookings must be for procedures.

* Bookings are counted per unique patient.

* Duplicate bookings do not count.

* Cancelled/rescheduled appointments do not count as additional bookings.



### Monthly Bonus



Complete **more than 200 qualified bookings in a month** and receive an additional:



**$20 CAD monthly bonus**



## Performance Expectations



You are expected to achieve a minimum of **5 bookings per day**.



If you complete **fewer than 25 bookings in one week**, you will enter a **one-week probation period**.



During the probation week, you must achieve **more than 30 bookings**.



Employees who accumulate **3 probation weeks within a 12-month period** will be subject to termination.

title: Senior Web Developer & SEO Specialist (HIPAA Healthcare, Luxury Brand)
description:
Senior Web Developer & SEO Specialist: HIPAA-Compliant Luxury Healthcare Site (Remote, Contract)



About Caldwell Private Health



SEE THE WEBSITE TO UNDERSTAND - 



Caldwell Private Health (
) is a private, membership-based men's health practice serving high-performing men across South Florida: founders, CEOs, and executives. Members get physician-supervised hormone optimization, at-home lab draws, a 90-minute physician consultation, quarterly lab reviews, compounded medications shipped to their door, and personal training and nutrition coaching.



Our brand sits closer to private banking than to a clinic. Everything a member touches must feel luxury, discreet, and effortless.



**Brand system:** Navy (#0F1B2D), gold (#C9A84C), cream (#F0EBE0). Typography: Cormorant Garamond + Montserrat. Tagline: *Performance. Precision. Discretion.*



Who We Need



This is not a template job. You must be equally strong in all three areas below. If you are strong in only one of them, please don't apply.



1. Healthcare-grade security.** You have shipped HIPAA-compliant web applications. You understand the HIPAA Security Rule, Business Associate Agreements (BAAs), encryption at rest and in transit, access controls, audit logging, and secure coding.

2. **Luxury front-end design and development.** Your portfolio proves your taste.

3. **SEO.** You can show real ranking results, including local SEO.



## The Core Principle: Security Is Built In, Not Added Later



Our current site was built quickly using AI-assisted tools. Our healthcare attorney has advised that AI-generated code and unvetted open-source frameworks are the most dangerous way to build a site that touches patient data. We expect to **rebuild the site from the ground up with HIPAA encryption as a core design requirement**, not patch the existing code.



Please apply only if you agree with that approach and know how to execute it.



## Scope of Work



Phase 1: Audit, Architecture & Competitor Review (together with the founder)**

- Do a full security, design, accessibility, and SEO audit of the current site (known issues are listed at the end of this post).

- Review 5–10 competitor and aspirational sites (concierge medicine, men's health, longevity clinics, luxury service brands). Deliver a written report covering what they do well, where we win, and what to adopt.

- Deliver a written architecture plan before any code is written. It must cover:

  - the stack

  - the hosting

  - how patient data flows

  - where data is encrypted

  - which vendors sign BAAs

  - the dependency list

  - the migration path



Phase 2: HIPAA-Compliant Build

- Encrypt any patient data the site touches, both in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256).

- Host on HIPAA-eligible cloud tiers (AWS or Azure) under a signed BAA.

- Prototype cheaply first, then migrate to the production HIPAA tier. Document the migration plan from day one so nothing needs to be rebuilt.

- Replace all forms that collect health information (intake, symptom questionnaire, assessment) with HIPAA-compliant handling covered by a BAA. Formspree must be removed.

- Keep tracking pixels, analytics, session recorders, and chat widgets off any page or form that collects health information. Recommend compliant analytics and ad-tracking alternatives.

- Follow secure-coding standards:

  - Use a minimal set of vetted, actively maintained dependencies.

  - Run dependency vulnerability scanning.

  - Follow the OWASP Top 10.

  - Set security headers (CSP, HSTS).

  - Add rate limiting and bot protection on all forms.

  - Store secrets properly, never in code.

- Use least-privilege access. You work in collaborator and staging accounts and never see or store patient data.

- Personally review and test all code. AI coding tools may be used only if every line is reviewed. Disclose your process.



Phase 3: Luxury Design & Front-End

- Rebuild and elevate every section, fixing every issue in the audit.

- Make the site pixel-perfect on desktop, tablet, and mobile, with mobile as the priority.

- Execute it like a luxury brand: refined motion, generous whitespace, fast video, no layout shift, and one consistent call-to-action path.

- Achieve Lighthouse scores of 90+ in Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, and SEO.



Phase 4: ADA / Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA)

- Full screen-reader support (tested with VoiceOver and NVDA).

- Full keyboard navigation with visible focus states.

- Color contrast that passes AA, including gold on cream, which must be checked.

- Descriptive alt text on all images, and captions on all video.

- Proper heading structure, form labels, and error messages.

- An accessibility statement page.



Phase 5: Legal Pages & Enrollment Flow

- **Two separate pages: a Privacy Policy AND a Notice of Privacy Practices (NPP).** They must never be combined. Also a Terms of Use page and a medical disclaimer. All of these are linked in the footer and on every form.

- Our attorney provides the documents. You implement them exactly as written.

- The Membership Agreement (which carries HIPAA language) is not a website page, but it must plug into the enrollment flow. Enrollment follows this order: application → agreement e-signed through a HIPAA-compliant e-sign provider → payment → onboarding in our CRM (GoHighLevel) and our EHR .

- Every step must be secure, logged, and seamless for the member.



Phase 6: SEO

- Technical SEO: schema markup (MedicalBusiness, Physician, FAQ), sitemap, canonical tags, Core Web Vitals, meta tags, and designed social share images.

- Move from a single page to a proper site architecture: service pages (TRT, hormone optimization, labs, coaching), location pages (Fort Lauderdale, Miami, Boca Raton, West Palm Beach), a physician page, and blog and podcast templates.

- Local SEO, including Google Business Profile, consistent business name/address/phone details across listings, and citations.

- Set up Google Search Console and compliant analytics, with monthly reporting.



**Phase 7: Handover or Ongoing Management**

- **Option A (handover):** Full documentation, including architecture, credentials transfer, and a BAA/vendor list. Also a recorded walkthrough and a 30-day support window.

- **Option B (retainer):** Monthly management covering security patching, uptime and security monitoring, SEO, content publishing, and monthly reports. Please quote this separately.



Requirements



- 5+ years of web development experience.

- At least one shipped HIPAA-compliant project. Be ready to explain its architecture.

- Hands-on experience with HIPAA-eligible AWS or Azure services.

- WCAG 2.1 AA experience, with audited examples.

- A portfolio of premium or luxury sites.

- Proven SEO results with numbers.

- Fluent written English, and at least 3–4 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern Time.

- Willing to sign an NDA, an independent contractor agreement, and a BAA if required.

- GoHighLevel experience is a plus.



How to Apply



Send the following:

1. Links to 2–3 luxury or premium sites you built.

2. A short description of a HIPAA-compliant project you built: the stack, the hosting, how you handled encryption, and which vendors signed BAAs.

3. One SEO result, with numbers.

4. Five specific issues you see on 
.

5. A fixed-price quote for Phases 1–6, and a monthly rate for Phase 7.

6. Start the first line of your message with the word **"Reserve"**.



Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid test task and a technical interview.



Appendix: Known Issues on the Current Site



Security & compliance

- Formspree handles health-related form data and does not sign a BAA.

- The site was built with AI tools, and the codebase and dependencies are unvetted.

- There are no Privacy Policy, NPP, Terms, medical disclaimer, or accessibility statement links in the footer.

- Some claims need legal review: "compounded specifically for you," "direct access 24/7," and outcome promises.



Design & UX

- Three different CTA labels ("Request Access," "See If You Qualify," "Book Your Assessment") point to two different destinations.

- The About, Services, and How It Works links all jump to the same anchor (#what).

- Vimeo player controls (speed menu, unmute) appear on the hero video instead of a clean background loop.

- Step images are duplicated in the markup.

- Stray hyphens break sentences ("-your hormones," "-what's off," "-not mass-produced"). Rewrite them as clean sentences with no dashes.

- The hero subline is weak ("Full picture of your health with your personal physician").

- The physician bio is too long for the page and mentions treating women, which is off-brand for a men's practice.

- The stats strip may run labels together ("1-on-1Physician Access").

- The decorative "Reserve Member Card" has no function.

- The footer has no phone,
, or address.



Accessibility

- Alt text is generic ("Step 1") and duplicated.

- The hero video has no captions control or pause control.

- Gold-on-cream contrast likely fails AA.



SEO

- The site is a single page, so it can't rank for separate services or cities.

- The body text never mentions "TRT" or "testosterone," even though the title and meta description target them.

- The H1 has no keywords.

- The share image is the raw logo PNG (2727×1405) instead of a designed 1200×630 card.

- Business name, address, and phone are missing, and there is no schema markup.

Built out webinar presentations before

Design sense and good taste



This is a role where I want to be able to hand you something and trust it gets done right. The more you can take off my plate, the more valuable you are to me. If you're the kind of person who likes owning systems and making them run smoothly, we'll get along great.

title: Customer Service Representative – Homecare Operations
description:
# Customer Service Representative – Homecare Operations  

**Registered Nurse Experience Required**



**Join our mission to help seniors live longer, healthier, and happier lives at home.**



We are looking for a capable, compassionate, and highly organized **Customer Service Representative with prior Registered Nurse experience** to support our Homecare Sales, Client Services, and Caregiver Recruitment teams.



This is **not a traditional nursing position**.



You do not need to be currently working as a nurse or maintain an active RN license. However, you should have **real professional experience working as a Registered Nurse**, preferably in the Philippines.



Your nursing background gives you something very valuable in this role: the ability to understand people, listen carefully, recognize concerns, communicate clearly, and help families navigate important decisions about care.



If you are an experienced nurse who is ready to apply your knowledge in a broader business and customer-service role, this may be a strong fit.



## What You’ll Do



### Help Families Find the Right Care



You will often be one of the first people families speak with when they are considering homecare for a parent or loved one.



You will:



- Speak with prospective clients and families with empathy, professionalism, and confidence

- Handle pre-screened calls transferred from our Care Coordination team

- Help families understand the next steps in starting homecare services

- Schedule consultations directly into our calendar system

- Follow up thoughtfully with families who are interested but not yet ready to move forward

- Build trust through clear, responsive, and respectful communication



### Support Our Caregiver Recruitment Team



You will also assist with caregiver recruitment and communication, including:



- Following up with caregiver applicants

- Helping coordinate interviews and next steps

- Maintaining organized recruitment records

- Supporting communication between Recruiting, HR, Scheduling, and Operations



### Become Part of the Homecare Operations Team



This position provides exposure to multiple parts of a growing homecare organization.



You may assist with:



- Customer service

- Sales support

- Marketing follow-up

- Scheduling

- Care coordination

- Caregiver recruitment

- Administrative tasks

- Billing and payroll support

- Data tracking and spreadsheets



You will learn and use systems such as:



- **Wel
rsonal Care**

- **Google Workspace**

- **Google Calendar**

- **Google Sheets**

- **Microsoft Excel**

- CRM and communication systems

- Other homecare technology platforms



## Who We’re Looking For



We are looking for someone who brings more than nursing knowledge.



You should be someone who is comfortable communicating with people, learning technology, solving problems, and taking responsibility for getting things done.



### Required



- Previous professional experience working as a **Registered Nurse**

- Strong spoken and written English

- Excellent communication and customer-service skills

- Comfortable speaking with clients, families, caregivers, and applicants

- Strong computer and technology skills

- Good organizational and follow-up habits

- Detail-oriented and dependable

- Comfortable learning new systems and processes



**An active RN license is not required.**



## You May Be an Excellent Fit If You Are:



- A former or experienced RN who wants to move beyond traditional bedside nursing

- Comfortable speaking with families and helping them make important decisions

- Naturally organized and good at keeping track of details

- Comfortable working with spreadsheets, calendars, software, and technology

- Someone who follows through rather than waiting to be reminded

- Able to work independently while still being a strong team member

- Interested in learning how a successful homecare company operates

- Looking for a position where you can develop broader professional skills over time



## Why Join Us?



Our mission is simple:



**Help seniors live longer, healthier, and happier lives in their own homes and communities.**



The work you do will directly support families looking for care and caregivers looking for meaningful employment.



You will also have the opportunity to develop experience across several areas of homecare operations rather than being limited to one narrow responsibility.



We value:



- Compassion

- Professionalism

- Accountability

- Authentic communication

- Continuous learning

- Teamwork

- Long-term relationships



We are looking for someone who wants to **grow with the organization**, learn new responsibilities, and become a trusted part of the team.



**Immediate start available for the right candidate.**



## How to Apply



Please complete your **OnlineJobs.ph profile fully before applying.**



We review completed profiles carefully, so please make sure your nursing experience, work history, skills, and previous responsibilities are clearly listed.



In your application, use the subject line:



**GOOGLE**

title: Digital Marketing & SEO Virtual Assistant
description:
**Website | Local SEO | Google Business Profile | Lead Generation**



We operate a growing home care company with a clear mission:



**Help seniors live longer, healthier, and more independent lives in their own homes.**



We are building for the long term. That means we care about **results, sustainability, accountability, and systems that actually work** — not vanity metrics, buzzwords, shortcuts, or activity that looks busy but produces no real business.



We are looking for a skilled **Digital Marketing & SEO Virtual Assistant** who understands how websites, local SEO, Google Business Profiles, landing pages, call tracking, and digital marketing work together to generate **qualified inquiries and real phone calls**.



This is a **hands-on execution role**.



We are not looking for someone who only gives recommendations or creates reports. We need someone who can identify what needs improvement, make the changes, track the results, and keep improving the system over time.



## Your Main Goal



Your job is simple to understand:



**Help more qualified families find us, trust us, and contact us for home care services.**



Traffic alone does not impress us.



Rankings alone do not impress us.



Clicks alone do not impress us.



We care about whether our marketing produces **qualified calls, inquiries, consultations, and ultimately new clients.**



## What You’ll Be Responsible For



### Website Management



- Maintain and update website pages and content

- Make basic UX and conversion improvements

- Improve mobile usability

- Monitor site speed and performance

- Maintain basic technical SEO hygiene

- Build and improve service pages and landing pages

- Support location-specific pages for local lead generation

- Identify and fix obvious website problems that may reduce conversions



### Local SEO & On-Page SEO



- Optimize page titles, meta descriptions, headers, content, and internal linking

- Perform keyword research based on actual search intent

- Focus on keywords likely to produce calls and inquiries — not traffic for traffic’s sake

- Improve visibility within our service areas

- Monitor keyword rankings and local search performance

- Identify pages that are underperforming and make improvements

- Support local citation and directory consistency where appropriate

- Help strengthen the website’s overall local authority



### Google Business Profile Management



- Optimize and maintain Google Business Profile locations

- Publish useful posts, photos, and updates

- Monitor profile accuracy

- Support review monitoring and professional responses

- Track important activity such as:

  - Phone calls

  - Website visits

  - Direction requests

  - Search visibility

- Identify opportunities to improve local map visibility



### Digital & Call-Driven Marketing



We are especially interested in candidates who understand that for a local service business, **the phone call matters.**



You may:



- Support Google Ads or other digital campaigns designed to generate qualified calls

- Help improve landing pages and conversion messaging

- Assist with call tracking setup

- Review which campaigns, keywords, and pages generate calls

- Help distinguish between good leads and poor-quality inquiries

- Recommend and implement improvements based on actual call results

- Coordinate basic follow-up workflows connected to inbound leads



### Tracking, Reporting & Accountability



You will provide clear weekly reporting on:



- Website performance

- SEO progress

- Local search visibility

- Google Business Profile activity

- Calls and inquiries generated

- Landing-page performance

- Problems discovered

- Actions completed

- Priorities for the following week



We do not need complicated reports full of numbers nobody uses.



We want to know:



**What worked?  

What didn’t?  

Why?  

What are we going to change next?**



## Required Skills & Experience



You should have hands-on experience with:



- WordPress or similar website platforms

- Local SEO

- On-page SEO

- Google Business Profiles

- Google Search Console

- Google Analytics

- Keyword research

- Landing-page optimization

- Basic call tracking

- SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, or similar platforms



Experience with local service businesses is strongly preferred.



Experience in home care, senior care, healthcare, or another phone-driven service business is a plus.



## You’re Likely a Strong Fit If You:



- Care more about results than buzzwords

- Can execute without constant supervision

- Think in systems rather than isolated tasks

- Can prioritize what will have the greatest business impact

- Are comfortable being measured on outcomes

- Take ownership when something is not working

- Communicate clearly and directly

- Can explain technical marketing concepts in simple language

- Pay attention to detail

- Follow through consistently

- Prefer long-term improvement over quick tricks



We also value someone who can say:



**“This isn’t working, and here is what I recommend we change.”**



We would rather hear the truth early than receive a polished report explaining poor results later.



## What This Position Is NOT



This is not:



- A social-media posting role

- An influencer or branding position

- A graphic-design-only job

- A strategy-only consulting position

- A role for someone who simply generates AI content and uploads it

- A place for spammy SEO, fake backlinks, fake reviews, or shortcuts

- A position where success is measured by impressions and clicks alone



## Work Details



- Remote / Virtual

- Part-time to start

- Opportunity to grow into a larger role

- Flexible working hours

- Outcome-focused

- Long-term position for the right person



For someone who performs well, this role has the potential to become an important part of our long-term marketing and growth system.



## How to Apply



Please send:



1. A brief summary of your relevant experience

2. Examples of websites you have managed

3. Examples of local SEO work you have completed

4. Examples of Google Business Profiles you have managed

5. A short explanation of how you would help a local home care company generate more qualified phone calls



If you have experience with call tracking, Google Ads, landing pages, or conversion optimization, please mention that as well.



Finally, if you have read this entire posting, put the word:



**GEMINI**



in the title or subject line of your application.



Applications without **GEMINI** may not be reviewed.

title: Full-Time SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
# Full-Time SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist

**Local SEO | Website Optimization | Google Business Profile | Lead Generation**



We are a growing home care company with a clear mission:



**Help seniors live longer, healthier, and more independent lives in their own homes.**



We are building for the long term.



Our marketing is measured by real business outcomes — not likes, impressions, vanity metrics, or activity that looks productive without generating results.



We are hiring a **full-time SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist** to work directly with our internal team.



This is a **direct-hire position**.



It is not an agency role, not a freelance project, and not a side job.



We are looking for someone who wants to become part of our organization, understand our business deeply, take ownership of results, and improve our marketing systems over time.



## Your Primary Goal



Your main responsibility is straightforward:



**Increase qualified inbound phone calls and inquiries from families looking for home care services.**



Everything else supports that goal.



Traffic matters only if it leads to the right people contacting us.



Rankings matter only if they improve visibility with prospective clients.



Marketing matters only if it produces measurable business results.



## What You Will Own



### Website Management & Optimization



You will help continuously improve our website by:



- Updating and improving website pages and content

- Managing WordPress or a similar CMS

- Improving site speed and mobile performance

- Improving usability and conversion flow

Responsibilities include:



- Keyword research based on **search intent**

- Identifying keywords that generate calls and inquiries rather than traffic alone

- On-page SEO

- Page titles and meta descriptions

- Header structure

- Internal linking

- Content optimization

- Local service-area optimization
