title: Amazon Account & PPC Specialist — CPG Food Brand (Part-Time, Remote)
description:
About the Role

We're a growing CPG (consumer packaged goods) food brand selling a specialty baking/dessert ingredient, sold direct-to-consumer online, in national retail stores, and on Amazon. We're looking for an experienced Amazon Account & PPC Specialist to take over day-to-day management of our Amazon business — currently handled by an outside agency — and run it directly, with room to also support advertising on other retail platforms (e.g., Instacart) as that grows. Full company name and brand details will be shared directly with the candidate we move forward with.



This role is focused on the day-to-day management and optimization of Amazon: PPC advertising, marketplace operations, profitability tracking, and performance analysis. We're looking for someone who has previously managed Amazon accounts for CPG, food, or beverage brands, speaks the language fluently, and can work independently to identify opportunities, solve problems, and drive results.



One thing to know before you apply: AI-powered PPC, bid, and analytics tools are fully expected here — that's normal for this work. But our product listing copy, A+ Content, and Storefront are customer-facing, so final versions of those need to be human-edited and true to our actual brand voice, not shipped as raw AI output. See "How we use AI" below.



Work Structure & Requirements

- Location: Remote

- Schedule: Part-time, approximately 10 hours/week

- Time zone: Needs meaningful overlap with US Eastern (EST) business hours for coordination — please note your available hours relative to EST when you apply

- Compensation: $7USD/hour to start, with room to grow based on experience and results 



What you'll do:



Amazon PPC & Performance

- Own day-to-day management and optimization of Amazon PPC campaigns across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and other relevant ad formats

- Conduct keyword research, search-term analysis, and competitor research

- Optimize bids, budgets, targeting, and campaign structures

- Launch and manage new campaigns and testing initiatives

- Monitor ACOS, TACOS, ROAS, CPC, conversion, and overall sales performance

- Track profitability at the ASIN/SKU level, including COGS and FBA fees

- Identify underperforming areas and proactively recommend improvements

- Provide clear, direct weekly reporting on performance, learnings, and recommended next steps



P&L & Profitability Management

- Maintain a clear view of Amazon P&L — revenue, ad spend, FBA fees, COGS, and overall profitability

- Proactively flag margin risks and identify opportunities to improve profitability

- Translate data into clear, actionable recommendations



Listing Optimization & Content

- Review and optimize Amazon product listings — titles, bullet points, imagery, and product content

- Collaborate on A+ Content, video, and creative assets (final customer-facing copy/content is human-reviewed — see "How we use AI" below)

- Maintain and improve our Amazon Storefront

- Keep listings accurate, conversion-focused, and brand-aligned

- Monitor competitor activity and category trends



Retail Media (Other Platforms)

- Support advertising on other relevant retail media platforms as our presence there grows (e.g., Instacart)

- Apply Amazon PPC learnings and best practices across those platforms

- Monitor spend and performance across channels and flag optimization opportunities



Account Health & Operations

- Monitor account health and proactively flag potential issues

- Raise and manage Amazon Seller Support cases through to resolution

- Troubleshoot listing, inventory, fulfillment, and account-related issues

- Support inventory/logistics coordination to help maintain product availability



How we use AI:

We're fully on board with AI-powered tools for PPC bidding, keyword/competitor research, and performance analytics — use whatever makes you faster and sharper at this job. The one place we draw a line is customer-facing content: final product listing copy, A+ Content, and Storefront pages should be human-written or human-edited to sound like us, not raw AI output shipped as-is.



What we're looking for:

- 2+ years of hands-on Amazon marketplace and Amazon PPC experience, ideally managing accounts for CPG, food, or beverage brands — you must provide examples demonstrating measurable results (e.g., ACOS, ROAS, or profitability improvements)

- Demonstrated ability to manage and track Amazon P&L, including profitability at the ASIN/SKU level, COGS, and FBA fees

- Deep fluency with Amazon Seller Central, Amazon Ads, FBA operations, listing optimization, and resolving Seller Support cases

- Clear, direct, concise communicator — comfortable giving straight answers and actionable weekly reports rather than long, indirect updates

- Comfortable analyzing data and turning it into specific, prioritized recommendations

- Highly organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and able to work independently



Nice to have:

- Hands-on Instacart Ads experience (campaign setup, optimization, performance management)

- Meta Ads experience

- Familiarity with Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or similar tools

- Comfortable with Google Workspace and Slack



To apply:

Please send your resume, 2–3 examples of measurable Amazon results you've driven (ACOS/ROAS/profitability improvements), and a short video introduction. Applications without examples of previous work will not be considered.

The ideal person will be someone who doesn't just ask:

Instead, they look at the footage and say:



"Here's what I think we should make."



You should be comfortable making creative decisions and bringing your own ideas to the table. I want an editor who can become familiar with my brand, my personality, my audience, and the fitness niche and eventually understand what type of content fits my brand without needing constant direction.

title: Automation / Data Engineer (Part-Time) — Build a Lead Enrichment Engine
description:
We run a B2B lead generation pipeline built on public business filing data. Records come in on an automated pull, get scored and tiered, and route to our sales team through  CRM.



The problem: contact enrichment is still manual. Two people research each record by hand to find phone numbers and
s, and they can't keep pace with volume. Our highest-value records go stale before anyone touches them.



Your job is to make that step disappear.



This is a build project first, with ongoing part-time work maintaining and extending the system afterward if it goes well.



What you'll build



Automated enrichment. Integrate third-party data APIs to resolve contact information without human involvement. Includes deduplication and caching so we never pay twice for the same lookup, phone line type validation, and fallback logic when a lookup fails.



Automated lead scoring. Our raw data contains signals we aren't currently computing. You'll derive them at ingest and build them into a scoring model that runs on every record automatically. I need to be able to adjust scoring weights myself without asking you for a code change.



Prioritized review queue. Records that fail automated lookup go to a human queue, ordered by record value and freshness rather than first in first out.



Monitoring and alerting. This matters as much as the build. The system runs unattended against paid APIs and feeds a queue our sales team depends on. I need failure alerts, spend anomaly alerts, rate limit handling with backoff, and retry logic that doesn't duplicate paid lookups. A silent failure costs real money.



Documentation. A deliverable, not an afterthought. System documentation, a runbook for common failures, and a walkthrough where I can demonstrate I understand how to operate it. I built the current pipeline myself and I'm not willing to end up unable to troubleshoot my own system.



Required

Strong Python, or n8n plus Python

Real experience integrating third-party APIs, including handling rate limits, pagination, retries, and auth

Experience working with large volumes of messy record data: deduplication, normalization, fuzzy matching on names and addresses

A database background (PostgreSQL or similar)

You've built something that ran unattended in production and you know what it takes to keep it running

Clear English



Nice to have

Google Apps Script and Google Sheets API

Close CRM or comparable CRM APIs

Experience with skip trace, identity, or B2B contact enrichment vendors

Dashboarding (Looker Studio, Metabase, or similar)

Any background in lending, MCA, fintech.

title: TikTok Shop Manager — CPG Food Brand (Part-Time, Remote)
description:
About the Company

We're a growing CPG (consumer packaged goods) food brand selling a specialty baking/dessert ingredient. Our product is sold direct-to-consumer online and in national retail stores, and we're now growing our presence on TikTok Shop. Our brand voice is fun, playful, bold, and trendy. We care about authenticity, in our product and in how we show up online — nothing customer-facing that comes out of this role should be AI-generated. Full company name and brand details will be shared directly with the candidate we move forward with.



A growing CPG food brand is looking for a TikTok Shop Manager to build and run our TikTok Shop storefront from the ground up. You'll own everything that turns our existing TikTok following into TikTok Shop sales — this is a high-impact role for someone who understands both the TikTok Shop platform and how to sell a food/CPG product.



One thing to know before you apply: we don't let AI write anything that reaches our customers or affiliates directly. See "How we use AI" below.



What you'll do:

- Set up and continuously optimize our TikTok Shop product catalog — titles, descriptions, images, pricing, and categories for each product variant

- Recruit, onboard, and manage affiliate creators through TikTok's Creator Marketplace/affiliate program to promote our products in exchange for commission, growing our reach beyond our own account

- Plan and coordinate livestream shopping events (LIVE selling), including scheduling hosts, prepping talking points, and promoting the stream in advance

- Set up and manage TikTok Shop ads (Shop Ads / GMV Max) and promotional tools — vouchers, flash sales, bundle deals — to drive conversions

- Monitor TikTok Shop analytics (views, click-through, conversion rate, GMV) and report weekly on what's working, with recommendations to improve

- Keep inventory, pricing, and order fulfillment in sync between TikTok Shop and our online store

- Handle TikTok Shop customer questions, reviews, and any order issues, in your own words

- Stay current on TikTok Shop policy, algorithm, and feature changes and flag anything that affects our strategy

- Work with our content creator to make sure videos link to the right products and use TikTok Shop's shoppable video/showcase features



Why this role matters:

TikTok Shop turns our existing audience (already posting 3–5 videos per day) directly into a sales channel instead of just brand awareness. A dedicated manager means affiliate creators start promoting us at scale, live selling events convert real-time interest into purchases, and our catalog and ads are actually optimized instead of left on autopilot — all of which should meaningfully grow TikTok-driven revenue.



How we use AI:

We're happy to use AI-powered tools for things like ad optimization, analytics, and workflow efficiency — that's a normal part of running a lean shop. But nothing that reaches a real customer or affiliate directly (messages, responses, reviews) should be written by AI and passed off as us. Real, human communication is part of how we keep customer trust.



What we're looking for:

- Proven experience managing a TikTok Shop for a brand — you must provide examples of previous work (e.g., shops you've set up/managed, GMV or affiliate-growth results)

- Familiarity with TikTok's Seller Center, Creator Marketplace, and TikTok Shop ads

- Comfortable with basic e-commerce operations (inventory, order sync, fulfillment coordination)

- Data-comfortable — able to read shop analytics and turn them into a clear action plan

- Strong written English for creator outreach and customer service, in your own voice

- Self-directed; comfortable owning a channel with minimal day-to-day oversight



Nice to have:

- Experience in food, beverage, or CPG brands

- Experience hosting or producing livestream shopping events

- Familiarity with Shopify



Schedule & pay:

Part-time, remote, ongoing — starting at approximately 5 hours/week at $5.00 /hour, with hours and rate potentially increasing depending on your experience and the results you deliver.



To apply:

Please include 2–3 examples of TikTok Shops you've managed and any GMV or affiliate-growth results you can share. Applications without examples of previous work will not be considered.

title: Short-Form Video Editor / TikTok Content Creator/ UGC content — CPG Food Brand (Part-Time, Remote)
description:
About the Company

We're a growing CPG (consumer packaged goods) food brand selling a specialty baking/dessert ingredient. Our product is sold direct-to-consumer online and in national retail stores, and we're now growing our presence on TikTok Shop. Our brand voice is fun, playful, bold, and trendy. We care about authenticity, in our product and in how we show up online — nothing customer-facing that comes out of this role should be AI-generated. Full company name and brand details will be shared directly with the candidate we move forward with.



A growing CPG food brand with an active TikTok presence is looking for a skilled short-form video editor to turn our raw footage into scroll-stopping, UGC-style TikTok and Instagram content. We have raw photos/video organized by product variant and a founder-recorded voiceover track for most videos, and want someone who can take that material and produce polished, on-brand videos we can batch and schedule ahead of time.



One thing to know before you apply: nothing customer-facing here is AI-generated. No AI video, no AI images, no AI voiceover — everything we post is real. See "How we use AI" below.



What you'll do:

- Edit raw photo/video clips (organized by product variant) into finished short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, Pinterest,
, and
/X

- Sync in voiceover audio provided by the founder (all voiceover narration is recorded by the founder personally — this is not part of your role), and add trending sounds, captions, and on-screen text in a fun, playful, bold, trendy style

- Write scripts and talking points for the founder to record as voiceover, when asked

- Follow current TikTok/UGC trends and food-content formats and adapt them to fit our products

- Write short, trend-aware, scroll-stopping captions and hooks tied to food/baking trends

- Help plan and manage a content calendar so a batch of content shot in one day can be scheduled out across the following week(s)

- Repurpose one piece of content into multiple formats/platforms to maximize each shoot

- Keep messaging consistent with our core selling points: consistent quality at any batch size, better-for-you ingredients, and strong value/convenience positioning

- Flag which existing videos are performing well so we can double down on similar formats



Why this role matters:

Right now, content output is limited by the founder's time. A dedicated editor turns raw footage and founder-recorded voiceover into a steady, professional-looking stream of content, frees up the founder's time to focus on the business, and lets us actually hit a consistent weekly batch-and-schedule workflow — which should improve watch time, follower growth, and ultimately traffic into our TikTok Shop and online store.



How we use AI:

Every video we post is built from real footage and a real, founder-recorded voiceover — no AI-generated video, images, avatars, or synthetic voiceover, ever. That's a real part of our brand identity, not just a policy. You're welcome to use AI tools for your own workflow — research, trend-spotting, organizing footage — but the final edit, captions, and creative direction need to be real, hand-made work that you stand behind.



What we're looking for:

- A strong portfolio of short-form video edits (TikTok/Reels) — you must provide examples of previous work (please include links)

- Skilled with tools like CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar

- Understanding of what makes food/lifestyle content perform on TikTok (pacing, hooks, trending audio, captions)

- Comfortable working from raw footage, a provided voiceover track, and loose direction, not just a shot list

- Good written English for captions, scripts, and creative suggestions

- Reliable turnaround and comfortable with a weekly batch-delivery schedule



Nice to have:

- Experience creating UGC-style content for food, beverage, or beauty brands

- Basic graphic design skills (Canva or similar) for thumbnails/covers



Schedule & pay:

Part-time, remote, ongoing — starting at approximately 5 hours/week at $5.00/hour, with hours and rate potentially increasing depending on your experience and the results you deliver.



To apply:

Please share your portfolio/reel and tell us your typical turnaround time and hours for a batch of 10–15 short videos. Applications without examples of previous work will not be considered.

title: YouTube Video Editor (Tech & AI)
description:
Hey! I'm Giovanni. I run TechGio, a YouTube channel about tech sales, AI, and building a startup. I'm looking for one talented long-form editor to grow the channel with me. If you love clean, premium talking-head content and you're excited about tech and AI, this one's for you.



THE QUICK VERSION



- What: Long-form YouTube only. Talking-head + screen recordings. No Shorts.

- How many: 2–3 videos a week (8–12 a month once we're rolling)

- Pay: $50–$100 per video based on experience and quality. Roughly $500–$1,000+/month, with raises as your work speaks for itself.

- Turnaround: First cut within 48 hours of getting footage.

- Where: Fully remote. I'm in Houston, Texas. You can be anywhere.

- Channel: 



ABOUT THE CHANNEL



TechGio started as me documenting my own path into tech sales and helping people break in with no experience. I work in tech sales and that's still the heart of the channel: what the job is really like, earnings breakdowns, day-in-the-life.



Now it's growing. I'm going deeper into AI and the tech industry (new model releases, the tools I actually use, what's changing and what it means for you). And I'm building my own startup on the side, so I'll be sharing the founder journey while working full-time.



I've worked with an editor before and it went great. Now I want more videos, more polish, and one editor who becomes a true long-term partner. Someone who grows with the channel and wins when it wins. Hopefully that's you!



WHAT YOU'LL DO



I batch-film. You get raw footage (Sony A7 IV), screen recordings, and a short brief with the hook, structure, and the moments I want to hit. Then you run the edit:



- Cut it tight. Trim dead air and bad takes, keep the energy up. Retention is the whole game.

- On-screen text and captions. Callouts, key numbers, lists. Sharp and well-timed. This is a big part of the style.

- Simple, polished motion. Diagrams for AI concepts, tool and UI highlights, clean transitions. Think Jeff Su, not MrBeast.

- Screen recording polish. Zooms, cursor highlights, blur anything sensitive.

- Music, sound design, and clean dialogue audio.

- Color, final export, and organized project files.

- Quick revisions from my timestamped notes. Usually one round.



THE STANDARD



Watch a couple of these before you apply so we're on the same page:



- Jeff Su: 
 (the golden example: clean, tight, sharp text, subtle motion, never overdone)

- Liam Ottley: 
 (clear diagrams and callouts that make AI simple)

- Dan Martell: 
 (bold text, strong pacing, premium feel)



If you watched those and thought "I can edit at that level," keep reading.



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR



- You've edited long-form YouTube talking-head content before, ideally for tech, business, or productivity channels, and you have published videos to prove it.

- Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve, plus After Effects or similar. You make text and motion look premium.

- You use AI in your workflow. Descript, auto-captions, the AI features in your editor, whatever works for you. My whole operation runs that way.

- You're into tech and AI, or genuinely curious about it. It shows in the edit when the editor cares.

- Fast and reliable. If something's going to slip, I hear about it before it does. I'll always do the same for you.

- Coachable and hungry. I give clear feedback and I'm easy to work with.

- Fluent English. We'll work mostly async on Slack or WhatsApp.



One honest ask: please don't apply if you're just getting started or if your portfolio is mostly Shorts, gaming, or event videos. Nothing wrong with that work, it's just not this role. I need someone who can hit a high bar from day one.



WHAT YOU GET



- Steady, consistent work. 8–12 videos a month.

- Raises tied to quality. Good work gets rewarded here, I truly mean that.

- Tools covered. Software, plugins, stock music, assets. If you need it to do the job well, I'm happy to help pay for it.

- Room to grow. As the channel and the startup take off, there's going to be a lot more to make. You get first look at all of it.

- A real voice. I want your ideas on pacing, hooks, and style. You're a creative partner here, not just a pair of hands.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your message with the word "Mission" so I know you read the whole thing. Then send me:



1. 3 links to long-form YouTube videos you edited, and exactly what you did on each.

2. Your tools, including which AI tools you use.

3. How many 10–15 minute videos per week you can realistically deliver, and your usual first-cut turnaround.

4. Your rate per video.



The strongest applicants get a paid test edit before we commit to anything, so you get paid either way.



I need portfolio links to consider you, so please don't skip those. Can't wait to see what you've made and hopefully build something great together!



— Giovanni

title: PERSONAL BRAND CONTENT STRATEGIST & SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGER
description:
Employment Type: Part-Time with Opportunity to Grow

ABOUT THE ROLE



I am an entrepreneur based in Las Vegas building a personal brand around business, lifestyle, personality and personal evolution.



The central story is about an ambitious entrepreneur who spent years focused on building businesses and is now learning to enjoy the life he worked for—without losing his ambition.

• Behind-the-scenes business moments

• Cars, restaurants, travel, fitness and events

• Honest conversations about success, pressure and personal growth



I am looking for a creative and highly organized Personal Brand Content Strategist and Social Media Manager who can turn my real life, personality and experiences into compelling short-form content.



This is not a basic posting or Canva-graphics position. You must understand personal branding, storytelling, strong hooks and short-form video strategy.



RESPONSIBILITIES



• Develop a weekly content strategy based on my personal brand

• Create short-form video concepts for Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts

• Write strong hooks, talking prompts, captions and calls to action

• Prepare clear shot lists and filming instructions

• Help me identify moments from my real life that can become content

• Organize raw footage and coordinate with my video editor

• Maintain a consistent visual style, voice and brand identity

• Build and manage a weekly content calendar

• Schedule and publish approved content

• Repurpose strong content across multiple platforms

• Track views, retention, shares, saves, comments and follower growth

• Submit a short weekly performance report with recommendations

• Research relevant trends without allowing trends to dilute the brand

• Proactively suggest improvements based on performance



THE BRAND DIRECTION



The brand should feel:



• Cinematic

• Ambitious

• Authentic

• Confident

• Unpredictable

• Aspirational but still relatable



The content should combine polished lifestyle footage with raw, personality-driven moments. The goal is not to create a fake “guru” or luxury influencer. The goal is to build a recognizable world around a real entrepreneur and an unfolding personal journey.



IDEAL CANDIDATE



• Proven experience managing a personal brand or creator account

• Strong understanding of Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts

• Excellent English writing and communication skills

• Strong understanding of hooks, storytelling and audience retention

• Able to turn ordinary daily moments into interesting content

• Creative, organized and comfortable taking initiative

• Able to study analytics and make strategic adjustments

• Understands the difference between building a brand and chasing views

• Comfortable collaborating with a founder and video editor

• Interested in business, lifestyle and personality-based content



Video-editing experience is helpful but not required. This position is primarily focused on strategy, planning, organization, publishing and growth.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



During the first 30 days, we should:



• Establish a consistent personal-brand identity

• Build a repeatable weekly filming and publishing system

• Publish approximately 12–20 quality short-form videos

• Identify the strongest content themes, hooks and formats

• Reduce the amount of daily planning required from me

• Create a clear strategy based on actual performance data



HOW TO APPLY



Please include the following:



1. A brief explanation of your experience managing personal brands

2. Links to three accounts or projects you have worked on

3. Five short-form videos you helped plan, write or manage

4. A clear explanation of your role in those results

5. The metrics you use to evaluate short-form content

6. Your expected monthly salary for part-time work

7. Your availability and preferred working hours



Text me on whats app for quicker response

title: YouTube Thumbnail Designer (Tech & AI)
description:
Hey! I'm Giovanni. I run TechGio, a YouTube channel about tech sales, AI, and building a startup. I'm looking for one talented thumbnail designer to become my go-to for every video. If you obsess over what makes people click and you like clean, premium design over loud clickbait, this one's for you.



THE QUICK VERSION



- What: Thumbnails for long-form YouTube videos. Talking-head tech content.

- How many: 2–3 thumbnails a week (8–12 a month once we're rolling), with 2–3 variations per video so we can test.

- Pay: Starting around $20 per thumbnail, and I'm flexible for the right person. If your work is next level, tell me your rate. I'd rather pay more for someone great than save money on someone average.

- Turnaround: 24 hours from brief to first draft.

- Channel: 



ABOUT THE CHANNEL



TechGio started as me documenting my own path into tech sales and helping people break in with no experience. I'm an enterprise account executive at a tech company, and that's still the heart of the channel: what the job is really like, earnings breakdowns, day-in-the-life.



Now it's growing. I'm going deeper into AI and the tech industry (new model releases, the tools I actually use, what's changing and what it means for you). And I'm building my own startup on the side, so I'll be sharing the founder journey while working full-time.



I'm hiring a dedicated video editor separately. This role is thumbnails only, and I want one person who owns it: someone who learns the channel, builds a consistent look, and gets better with every video as we see what performs.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



For each video, I'll send you the title, a short brief on the hook and the angle, a few high-res photos of me (I can shoot specific expressions or poses on request), and any screenshots or assets you need. From there:



- Design 2–3 thumbnail variations per video so we can A/B test.

- Keep it clean and readable. Few words, big and bold. Clear focal point. Readable at phone size. Instantly obvious what the video is about.

- Build and maintain a consistent visual identity for the channel: colors, fonts, layout patterns, how my face and text work together.

- Handle cutouts, background removal, lighting and color on my photos, and sharp product or UI mockups when a video is about a tool.

- Quick revisions from my notes. Usually one round.

- Deliver final PNGs at 1280x720 plus the editable source files (Photoshop, Figma, or whatever you work in).



THE STANDARD



Go look at the thumbnails on these channels before you apply so we're on the same page:



- Jeff Su: 
 (the golden example: clean, minimal, sharp text, never overdone)

- Ali Abdaal: 
 (bright, friendly, consistent identity across hundreds of videos)

- Dan Martell: 
 (bold text, strong contrast, premium feel)

- Liam Ottley: 
 (makes AI topics look simple and clickable)



Think premium and clear, not MrBeast. If you looked at those and thought "I can do that," keep reading.



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR



- You've designed YouTube thumbnails for real channels before, ideally tech, business, or productivity, and you can show published examples. Even better if you can point to any that performed well.

- You're strong in Photoshop, Figma, or similar. Clean cutouts, good typography, and you know how to make a face and a few words pop.

- You think about click-through rate, not just "does it look nice." You understand what makes someone stop scrolling.

- You use AI in your workflow where it helps (background removal, generating elements, mockups, whatever). My whole operation runs that way.

- You're into tech and AI, or genuinely curious about it. It shows when the designer understands the topic.

- Fast and reliable. If something's going to slip, I hear about it before it does. I'll always do the same for you.

- Coachable and hungry. I give clear feedback and I'm easy to work with.

- Fluent English. We'll work mostly async on Slack or WhatsApp.



One honest ask: please don't apply if you're just getting started, or if your portfolio is mostly logos, social posts, or general graphic design with no YouTube thumbnails in it. Thumbnails are their own skill. I need someone who already has it.



WHAT YOU GET



- Steady, consistent work. 8–12 thumbnails a month, every month.

- Raises tied to results. If your thumbnails get clicks, your rate goes up. I truly mean that.

- Tools covered. Software, stock assets, fonts. If you need it to do the job well, I'm happy to help pay for it.

- Room to grow. As the channel and the startup take off, there's going to be a lot more to design: launch graphics, product visuals, social content. You get first look at all of it.

title: Daily Instagram Reels Editor (CapCut) — Long-Term
description:
Hey! I'm Giovanni. I'm 27, I work in tech sales, I'm building a startup on the side, and I'm going all in on my personal brand. One reel a day, every day, starting now. I'm looking for one editor to ride this with me from the ground floor.



This isn't a gig. I want someone who becomes my editor, learns my style, and grows with the page as it takes off. If that sounds like what you've been waiting for, keep reading.





THE QUICK VERSION



- What: Instagram Reels and TikToks. Talking-head "yapping" videos, get-ready-with-me, and day-in-the-life.

- How many: One reel a day to start, with room to grow to two.

- Pay: $10–$20 per reel based on experience and quality, with raises as we grow.

- Turnaround: 24 hours from raw footage to first cut.

- Tools: CapCut or the Instagram Edits app. Edits is a plus. We'll work in Slack.

- My page: 





WHY THIS IS A REAL OPPORTUNITY



Most editing jobs are a few videos and then silence. This is daily work, every single day, for as long as you're great at it. That's around 30 reels a month from one client, and the rate goes up as the page grows and you prove yourself.



I'll also train you. I have a full style guide for exactly how I want these edited, and I'll give you direct feedback until you've got it dialed in. You'll come out of this a much better editor than you came in. After that, you run it.



And there's more behind this page. I'm building DuoTrack, a fitness app, and there's a long-form YouTube channel too. When those take off, the person editing my daily reels is the first person I bring in. You're getting in early.





WHAT YOU'LL DO



I'll send raw footage every day through Slack with a quick note on the hook and the point of the video. From there:



- Cut it tight. Trim the pauses and rambling, keep the energy up, hook in the first second.

- Captions and on-screen text. Clean, well-timed, in our brand style. This is a big part of the look.

- Simple, tasteful edits. Zooms, cuts, B-roll placement, sound. Enough to hold attention, never overdone.

- Two styles: raw talking-head yapping reels, and GRWM or day-in-the-life vlogs with timestamps and title cards.

- Export ready-to-post, 9:16, no watermarks, for Reels, TikTok, and Shorts.

- Quick tweaks from my notes. Usually one round, often none.





THE STANDARD



Go look at these before you apply so we're on the same page:




 (the golden example for raw yapping reels. Our style guide is built around this.)


 (super engaging, feels real, great pacing)


 (clean lifestyle and GRWM style)


 (raw, personality-first talking-head content)



If you watched those and thought "I can edit like that, and I'd love to," you're who I'm looking for.





WHO I'M LOOKING FOR



- You've edited short-form content before (Reels, TikToks, or Shorts) and you can show me examples. Doesn't have to be for a big account.

- You're strong in CapCut or the Instagram Edits app.

- You're passionate about short-form. You watch Reels and notice why they work. You have opinions on hooks and pacing.

- You're comfortable in Slack and you're responsive. We'll talk every day.

- Fast and reliable. 24-hour turnarounds, and if something's going to slip, I hear about it before it does. I'll always do the same for you.

- Coachable. I'll train you on my style and give clear feedback, and you actually apply it.

- Fluent English, and you get the vibe of lifestyle and self-improvement content.



Please don't apply if you're looking for a quick one-off gig. This is a daily, long-term thing and I want someone who's excited about that.





WHAT YOU GET



- Daily, consistent work. Around 30 reels a month.

- Raises as your work speaks for itself. When the page grows, you grow with it.

- Real training. My full style guide and direct feedback from me until you've got it.

- First look at everything that comes next: the app launch content, the YouTube channel, all of it.

- A real voice. I want your ideas on hooks, trends, and what to try next. You're a creative partner, not just a pair of hands.





HOW TO APPLY



Start your message with the word "Liftoff" so I know you read the whole thing. Then send me:



1. 3–5 Reels or TikToks you edited, and exactly what you did on each.

2. Which editing app you use, and whether you've used Instagram Edits.

3. One reel from any of the accounts above and two sentences on why it works.

4. Your rate per reel and how many reels a week you can realistically handle.



The strongest applicants get a paid test edit, one real reel from real footage, before we commit. So you get paid either way.



I need to see your work to consider you, so please don't skip the links. Let's build something big.



— Giovanni

description:

This is NOT simply a data-entry position. We are looking for someone who understands real estate lead generation and can eventually become a key part of our acquisitions operation.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

• BatchLeads

• BatchDialer

• LandGlide

ChatGPT

Experience with additional real estate CRMs, PropStream, REI software, comparable-sales research, skip tracing, title/property research, or wholesaling systems is a plus.



WHO WE WANT

title: Telecommunications / Electrical Design Engineer – AutoCAD & Technical Work Packages (Part-Time)
description:
Engineering Project Desk is seeking a part-time remote Telecommunications / Electrical Design Engineer who can independently investigate engineering problems, evaluate equipment upgrades, propose defensible solutions, and produce clear drawings and technical work packages for review.



HOURS AND COMPENSATION

Approximately 15–20 hours per week. Initial target rate: USD $6–$8/hour, based on demonstrated capability. Higher compensation may be considered after proven performance. Remote work with agreed deadlines and scheduled coordination.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Analyze existing conditions and integration requirements using sanitized drawings, technical notes, and public equipment manuals.

• Research and compare technical solutions; document calculations, assumptions, alternatives, risks, and recommendations.

• Develop AutoCAD drawings, wiring/interconnection diagrams, equipment layouts, revisions, and PDF deliverables.

• Support telecommunications, radio communications, IP networking, audio/control interfaces, and DC power integration.

• Prepare bills of materials and technical work packages covering scope, removal/installation, wiring, configuration requirements, testing, acceptance criteria, and contingency steps.

• Cite technical sources by document title, revision, and page/section; reconcile drawings, BOMs, and written instructions.

• Flag missing information as TBD / ENGINEER TO CONFIRM. Never invent pinouts, ratings, settings, or design requirements.

• Maintain organized Google Drive project files, revision records, time reports, and QA/QC responses.



REQUIRED CAPABILITIES

• Electrical, electronics, telecommunications, or closely related engineering education and relevant practical design experience.

• Independent technical problem-solving and systems integration experience.

• Strong AutoCAD capability and ability to read schematics, manuals, and specifications.

• Clear written English and well-organized engineering documentation.

• Ability to explain and defend your own calculations, design choices, and deliverables during live discussion.

• Reliable remote availability for approximately 15–20 hours/week.



SANITIZED PROJECT WORKFLOW

Work uses fictional or sanitized project information and approved references. Follow confidentiality, access, and revision-control requirements. Do not upload project material to unapproved services or subcontract the work. Deliverables are drafts subject to owner technical review and approval.



SELECTION PROCESS

1. Initial application and portfolio screening.

2. First technical engineering test using a fictional/sanitized problem.

3. Additional progressively harder technical tests for applicants who advance, to assess engineering judgment, integration, calculations, drawings, and work-package quality.

4. Live technical verification/interview: explain your submission and respond to a changed requirement.

5. Paid finalist trial before a hiring decision, with scope, rate, and time limit agreed in advance.

Only shortlisted applicants advance. Assessment instructions and time expectations will be provided at each stage. Submit your own work and disclose any tools or assistance used; you must understand and explain every technical conclusion.



PROBATION AFTER HIRE

The probation period is 3 months / 90 days, with formal review gates at Day 30, Day 60, and Day 90. Reviews assess technical accuracy, independent problem-solving, research/source quality, drawing and work-package quality, communication, productivity, and confidentiality. The final probation decision is at Day 90. Access remains limited to approved sanitized materials throughout.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply directly through this job posting on OnlineJobs.ph using the website’s application system. Use the subject: Telecom Engineer – [Your Name]. Submit your application and communicate through OnlineJobs.ph. Include:

1. Resume and relevant engineering education/experience.

2. One example of a technical problem or equipment upgrade you solved independently: the problem, your reasoning, and result.

3. Your AutoCAD experience and examples of drawings/work packages you personally produced, with all client/employer and sensitive information removed. Share only material you are authorized to share.

4. Experience with telecommunications, electrical/control interfaces, IP networks, and DC power systems.

5. Expected hourly rate, weekly availability, time zone, and earliest start date.

6. Confirmation that you are willing to complete the staged assessments, live verification, paid finalist trial, and 3 months / 90 days probation with formal 30/60/90-day review gates.



Please do not send confidential documents from current or former employers.

title: Full-Time Social Media & Brand Manager (Remote)
description:
Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced, creative, and highly organized Social Media & Brand Manager to build and manage the online presence of a growing luxury residential construction and real estate brand. This is more than a posting role. You will be responsible for brand strategy, content planning, storytelling, social media management, creative coordination, and eventually buyer/Realtor lead generation.

The initial focus will be documenting the brand's first residential project from Day Zero through completion, with the marketing strategy gradually shifting toward property promotion and sales as the project nears completion.



Key Responsibilities

● Develop weekly and monthly social media strategies and content calendars.

● Manage Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Stories.

● Schedule and publish high-quality content consistently.

● Write engaging, professional, and premium captions and copy.

● Organize project photos, videos, renders, graphics, and marketing assets.

● Coordinate with video editors, graphic designers, photographers, and local content creators.

● Review raw footage and identify opportunities for Reels, TikToks, Shorts, Stories, and carousels.

● Communicate with management about what needs to be filmed and when.

● Document major construction milestones from demolition to completion.

● Maintain a consistent luxury brand identity, tone, and visual style.

● Research relevant trends while maintaining a sophisticated brand image.

● Monitor analytics, engagement, website traffic, inquiries, and leads.

● Maintain an organized database of potential buyers and Realtors.

● Support future property launches, private previews, floor plan releases, and sales campaigns.

● Prepare a concise weekly report covering content, upcoming filming needs, performance, and leads.



Content Pillars

Content should be built around:

1. The Build Demolition, excavation, foundation, framing, rough-ins, insulation, drywall, cabinetry, finishes, landscaping, and completion.

2. Construction Education Waterproofing, framing, insulation, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, windows, structural details, and other behind-the-wall work.

3. Design Kitchens, bathrooms, flooring, cabinets, lighting, fixtures, materials, architectural details, floor plans, and interior/exterior design.

4. Transformation Show the journey from Existing House → Demolition → Construction → Interior → Finished Home.

5. Brand Company philosophy, construction decisions, quality standards, founder/project insights, and behind-the-scenes stories.



Content Targets

Approximately:

● 2 high-quality Reels per week

● 1 carousel/photo post per week

● 3–7 Stories per week

● TikTok and YouTube Shorts adaptations

Quality is more important than quantity.



Capture everything. Post strategically.



Project Documentation

The manager will coordinate content capture for major milestones including:

● Day Zero / Existing Property

● Demolition

● Excavation & Foundation

● Framing

● Rough-ins / Mechanical

● Insulation & Drywall

● Cabinetry & Millwork

● Interior Finishes

● Exterior & Landscaping

● Near Completion

● Final Professional Photography & Video



All footage must be properly organized so it can be reused for future marketing and portfolio content.

Qualifications



● 3–5+ years of experience in social media, content management, digital marketing, or a related role.

● Proven experience managing social media for a business, brand, real estate, construction, architecture, design, or other visual industry.

● Strong knowledge of Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.

● Excellent written and verbal English.

● Strong copywriting, storytelling, and content strategy skills.

● Excellent organization and time management.

● Experience coordinating with creative professionals.

● Ability to analyze social media performance.

● Able to work independently and meet deadlines.

● Strong understanding of professional and luxury brand presentation.

● Reliable high-speed internet and professional remote-work setup.



Preferred

● Experience with luxury real estate, construction, architecture, interior design, or property development.

● Strong understanding of premium visual branding.

● Canva, Adobe, CapCut, or similar tools.

● Meta Business Suite and social analytics.

● Basic video editing and graphic design.

● Google Drive/content asset management.

● Website/WordPress/Webflow experience.

● Lead generation and digital marketing experience.

● Strong visual judgment and short-form storytelling skills.



Important: This is NOT a basic social media posting position.

We are looking for someone who thinks like a Brand Manager and Content Strategist.



You should be able to answer:

What should we film?

Why should we film it?

How should we present it?

When should we publish it?

What story does it tell?

How does it strengthen the brand?

How can it eventually generate buyers and Realtor relationships?



You are expected to proactively identify content opportunities and communicate filming requirements to management.



Growth Opportunities

High-performing candidates may have opportunities to:

● Lead the overall digital brand strategy.

● Manage social media for future projects.

● Lead creative and marketing team members.

● Manage photographers and content creators.

● Participate in property launches and sales campaigns.

● Advance into Senior Brand/Marketing Management.

● Receive performance-based incentives as the company grows.



Why Join?

● 100% remote position.

● Help build a luxury residential brand from the ground up.

● Document a complete residential project from Day Zero to finished home.

● Significant creative and strategic ownership.

● Opportunity to build a long-term portfolio and marketing system.

● Growth opportunities as the company expands into future projects.



How to Apply

Please send to: 

● Updated Resume/CV

● Links to 3–5 social media accounts or brands you have managed

● Portfolio or examples of your work

● 2–3 minute audio introduction

● Brief summary of your content strategy and creative coordination experience

● Brief explanation of why you are interested in the role



Application Questions

1. If demolition begins Monday, what content would you capture before, during, and after?

2. What would your first 30 days of content look like for a new luxury residential brand?

3. How would you turn a normal construction update into an engaging Reel?

4. What luxury brands have excellent social media branding, and why?

5. How would you balance brand building with future buyer and Realtor lead generation?



Subject: Social Media & Brand Manager Application – Your Full Name



Note: Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

 & General Administration

s

**Starting Pay:** $250 USD/week  

**Pay:** Weekly or daily automatic payments available  

**Hours:** 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM New York/Eastern Time  

**Openings:** 2  

**Start:** Immediately / Ready to start Monday



## 🚨 INTRODUCTION VIDEO REQUIRED



**DO NOT APPLY WITHOUT AN INTRODUCTION VIDEO.**



Applications without the requested video will not be reviewed.



---



# ABOUT THENYCMAID



thenycmaid is an established and growing cleaning service serving New York City.



This is not a startup trying to figure out how to find customers.



Our business currently:



- Generates approximately **5–10 new organic leads every day**

- Operates a network of **100+ websites**

- Generates business organically without relying on paid advertising

- Has earned **100+ Google reviews**

- Works with approximately **10 cleaners**, with plans to significantly expand our cleaner roster

- Recently completed **200+ cleaning services in a single month for the first time**

- Historically closes approximately **80% of qualified leads**



Our operation is heavily automated through **Full Loop CRM**, and we're looking for people who can oversee that system, provide excellent customer service, solve problems, and help us continue growing.



**Previous cleaning-service industry experience is required.**



# THE POSITIONS



We are hiring **two people**.



### Weekday Position



**Monday – Friday**  

8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time



### Weekend Position



**Saturday – Sunday**  

8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time



Please clearly indicate which schedule you are applying for.



# WHAT THIS JOB ACTUALLY IS



This isn't a traditional receptionist position where you simply answer a telephone.



You will essentially be the **human operator overseeing an automated cleaning-service system**.



Our technology handles much of the repetitive work automatically.



Your responsibility is to **monitor the operation, communicate with customers and cleaners, and step in when human attention is required.**



# HOW OUR AUTOMATED SYSTEM WORKS



Our normal workflow looks like this:



**1. A lead comes in organically.**



We currently receive approximately 5–10 new leads per day.



**2. The system processes the lead.**



Bookings and jobs move through Full Loop CRM.



**3. Jobs are automatically assigned to cleaners.**



Our cleaners have their own portals where they manage their assigned work.



**4. Cleaners receive notifications about upcoming jobs.**



They receive a 30-minute notice before their scheduled service.



**5. Cleaners check in and check out through their portals.**



**6. Customer payments are collected automatically.**



**7. Cleaner payments are processed automatically.**



**8. Review requests and customer follow-ups are automated.**



When automation isn't enough, **you step in.**



Your job is to keep an eye on the entire operation and make sure things are running correctly.



# YOUR COMMAND CENTER: COMHUB



Most of your working day will be spent inside **ComHub**.



ComHub brings all of our incoming communications into one place:



- Phone calls

-
s

- Text messages

- Website chats



You will stay logged into ComHub throughout your shift and actively monitor incoming communications.



## 60-SECOND RESPONSE STANDARD



Our goal is simple:



**Incoming communications should be acknowledged or responded to within 60 seconds whenever reasonably possible.**



You're not expected to completely solve every problem in 60 seconds.



You **are** expected to acknowledge the customer or cleaner quickly and begin handling the situation.



This is not a position where you check messages every 15 minutes.



Monitoring communications **is the job**.



# YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



You will be responsible for:



- Answering incoming customer calls

- Responding to texts

- Responding to
s

- Responding to website chats

- Following up with new leads

- Scheduling cleaning services

- Reviewing bookings

- Approving bookings when necessary

- Monitoring automatic job assignments

- Communicating with cleaners

- Handling scheduling changes

- Handling cancellations

- Resolving routine customer concerns

- Resolving routine cleaner issues

- Updating customer and job information

- Monitoring cleaner check-ins and check-outs

- Following up after services

- Helping satisfied customers leave Google reviews

- Helping convert one-time customers into recurring customers

- Identifying problems in the automated workflow

- Taking action when automation requires human assistance

- Helping recruit additional cleaners

- Helping grow and improve the company



# WE WANT PROBLEM SOLVERS



This requirement is extremely important.



**We do not want someone who runs to the boss every time something goes wrong.**



Of course, management is available when something genuinely requires escalation.



But if every minor scheduling issue, customer question, or cleaner problem results in:



**“Boss, what should I do?”**



this will not be a good fit.



We want someone who can:



**Identify the problem → Gather the information → Think → Make a reasonable decision → Solve it.**



As you learn the business, you should become increasingly independent.



We value people whose first thought is:



**“How can I solve this?”**



not:



**“Who can I give this problem to?”**



# CUSTOMER SERVICE IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



Fast responses alone aren't enough.



We want customers to feel that they're dealing with a professional company that actually cares about their experience.



That means:



- Being friendly

- Communicating clearly

- Taking ownership

- Solving problems

- Following up

- Keeping customers informed

- Turning unhappy customers into satisfied customers

- Asking satisfied customers for reviews



We don't just want a customer to book once.



Our ideal customer journey is:



**LEAD → BOOKING → GREAT SERVICE → RECURRING CUSTOMER → GREAT REVIEW → REFERRAL**



Your job directly influences that process.



# PERFORMANCE & KPIs



We believe employees should know exactly what success looks like.



You'll have **individual performance standards** as well as **company growth targets**.



## KPI #1 — RESPONSE TIME



**Target: 60 seconds**



Incoming calls, texts,
s, and chats should be acknowledged or responded to within approximately **60 seconds whenever reasonably possible during your active shift**.



## KPI #2 — LEAD CLOSE RATE



**Target: 80%+ of qualified leads**



thenycmaid historically averages approximately an **80% close rate**.



We want to maintain or exceed that.



This doesn't mean aggressively selling people.



It means:



- Answering quickly

- Understanding what the customer needs

- Knowing our services

- Answering questions confidently

- Handling reasonable objections

- Following up

- Making booking easy



When someone contacts us looking for a cleaning service that we can provide, our goal is to turn that opportunity into a booking.



Spam, duplicate inquiries, services we don't provide, out-of-service-area inquiries, and other clearly unqualified contacts do not count as qualified leads.



## KPI #3 — MONTHLY COMPLETED SERVICES



We recently exceeded:



**200 SERVICES/MONTH**



for the first time.



Our current target is:



**225+ SERVICES/MONTH**



Then we'll continue raising the target as the company grows.



This is a company-wide goal rather than something one employee controls alone.



## KPI #4 — RECURRING CUSTOMER RATE



Current:



**~32%**



Target:



**40%+**



We want more customers choosing recurring cleaning services.



When appropriate, you should help customers understand their recurring-service options and follow up with satisfied customers about booking again.



## KPI #5 — AVERAGE TICKET



Previous average:



**~$228**



Recent average:



**~$210**



Target:



**$225+**



Part of the recent decline came from offering customers a $20 review incentive.



We're moving that incentive toward **$10** while continuing to grow our reviews and customer satisfaction.



## KPI #6 — REVIEWS & REPUTATION



We already have **100+ Google reviews**.



We want that number to keep growing.



Satisfied customers should be encouraged to share their experience.



We care about both:



**Quantity of reviews AND quality of customer experience.**



## KPI #7 — ATTENDANCE & RELIABILITY



Attendance is critical.



This isn't work that can simply wait until tomorrow.



Customers and cleaners are communicating with us in real time.



You must:



- Log in on time

- Be ready to work at the beginning of your shift

- Remain available throughout your shift

- Monitor ComHub consistently

- Communicate immediately if a genuine emergency occurs



Repeated lateness, disappearing during shifts, or regularly missing communications will not work in this position.



## KPI #8 — INDEPENDENT PROBLEM SOLVING



We will also evaluate how effectively you solve normal operational issues **without unnecessarily escalating everything to management**.



As you gain experience, we expect you to become increasingly capable of running day-to-day operations independently.



# BONUSES



We believe people who help grow the company should have opportunities to participate financially in that success.



There will be opportunities for **performance bonuses in addition to base compensation**.



Bonus opportunities may be tied to:



- Maintaining or exceeding an 80% close rate

- Exceeding monthly service targets

- Increasing recurring-service percentage

- Generating positive reviews

- Increasing customer retention

- Improving average ticket

- Recruiting quality cleaners

- Reducing missed opportunities

- Improving operational efficiency

- Creating successful new processes

- Identifying additional revenue opportunities



Our bonus structure will continue evolving as the company grows.



# BRING US IDEAS



We don't want someone who simply follows instructions forever.



We want someone who learns the business and eventually starts noticing things we don't.



If you see something that could improve:



- Customer experience

- Conversion

- Scheduling

- Recurring bookings

- Reviews

- Cleaner recruiting

- Cleaner retention

- Pricing

- Average ticket

- Communication

- Automation

- Efficiency

- Revenue



**Tell us.**



We're open to listening.



Good ideas are valuable.



And when someone's ideas produce measurable results for the company, we're open to rewarding that contribution.



# CLEANER RECRUITING & GROWTH



We currently work with approximately **10 cleaners**, and we're looking to expand.



Part of this position may include helping us:



- Find additional cleaners

- Communicate with applicants

- Screen candidates

- Help with onboarding

- Maintain cleaner information

- Assist cleaners with the system

- Monitor cleaner reliability



As the company grows, there will be opportunities to take on additional responsibility.



# REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



### Cleaning-Service Experience Is Required



We're specifically looking for someone who already understands the service industry, preferably residential or commercial cleaning.



You should understand situations involving:



- Customers

- Cleaners

- Scheduling

- Rescheduling

- Cancellations

- Late cleaners

- No-shows

- Service complaints

- Quality issues

- Customer expectations

- Reviews

- Recurring services



You must also have **previous customer-service experience**.



Experience involving any of the following is highly valuable:



- Cleaning companies

- Home-service companies

- CRM systems

- Dispatching

- Scheduling

- Reception

- Phone support

- Call centers

- Customer retention

- Sales



Experience with **Full Loop CRM** is a plus.



# EQUIPMENT REQUIREMENTS



You must have:



- Reliable laptop/computer

- Quality headset

- Reliable Wi-Fi/internet connection

- Quiet environment for customer calls

- Reliable access to your equipment throughout your shift



Because this is a live customer-service position, your equipment and internet connection need to be dependable.



# WORK SCHEDULE & LUNCH



Working hours are:



**8:00 AM – 5:00 PM New York/Eastern Time**



You may take a:



**30-minute paid lunch break**



We will coordinate coverage so customer communications continue to be monitored.



# COMPENSATION



Starting compensation:



## $250 USD PER WEEK



This is starting compensation—not necessarily where we expect a strong employee to remain.



When we see someone succeeding, taking ownership, becoming independent, and helping grow the company, we're comfortable increasing compensation.



Raises are commonly:



**+$50 to +$100 per week**



as we see successful performance.



And we're comfortable going higher from there as someone's responsibilities and contribution increase.



**Performance bonuses are additional.**



# PAYMENT



Payments are handled automatically through **Stripe**.



You'll receive a secure link where you enter your name and Philippine banking information.



Payments are automatically issued:



**Every Thursday**



In most cases, funds are received by:



**Friday**



If you prefer to receive your compensation **daily instead of weekly**, automatic daily payment can also be arranged.



# APPLICANT PREFERENCE



**Male applicants are preferred for this opening.**



Qualified applicants will ultimately be evaluated based on their experience, communication skills, reliability, problem-solving ability, customer-service skills, and ability to perform the position successfully.



# 🚨 INTRODUCTION VIDEO REQUIRED



**WE WILL ONLY REVIEW APPLICANTS WHO SUBMIT THE REQUIRED INTRODUCTION VIDEO.**



No video = no interview.



Your video does NOT need:



- Professional editing

- Special lighting

- Fancy equipment

- Professional production



A normal phone or webcam recording is perfectly acceptable.



We want to see **you**.



## In Your Video, Answer ALL of the Following:



**1. Introduce yourself.**



Tell us your name and where you're located.



**2. Tell us about your previous work experience.**



**3. Describe your cleaning-service experience.**



Be specific about the company, your responsibilities, and what you actually did.



**4. Describe your customer-service experience.**



**5. Tell us about your experience answering customer phone calls.**



**6. Tell us about any CRM, scheduling, dispatching, or booking systems you've used.**



**7. Tell us about a time you had a problem at work and solved it yourself instead of immediately asking your manager what to do.**



**8. Tell us why you believe you'd be successful in this position.**



**9. Tell us whether you're applying for:**



**WEEKDAY — Monday through Friday**



or



**WEEKEND — Saturday and Sunday**



**10. Confirm that you can consistently work 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time.**



# VIDEO SCENARIO #1 — ANGRY CUSTOMER



Pretend we're the customer.



A customer calls and says:



**“My cleaner was supposed to arrive 20 minutes ago. Nobody is here. What's going on?”**



The customer is frustrated.



**Show us exactly how you would respond to that customer.**



Don't tell us what customer service means.



**Show us.**



# VIDEO SCENARIO #2 — CLEANER CANCELLATION



A cleaner contacts you and says:



**“I can't make it to my next job.”**



The customer is expecting someone shortly.



Explain:



**Exactly what would you do next?**



Walk us through your thought process.



# VIDEO SCENARIO #3 — SALES / BOOKING



A potential customer contacts us and says:



**“I'm comparing a few cleaning companies and haven't d
 who I'm going to use yet.”**



Show us how you would handle the conversation and attempt to turn that lead into a booking **without being pushy or unprofessional**.



# WHAT WE'RE ACTUALLY TESTING



The introduction video allows us to evaluate:



- Spoken English

- Communication

- Confidence

- Customer-service instincts

- Sales ability

- Professionalism

- Problem-solving

- Ability to think independently

- Ability to remain calm

- Understanding of the cleaning industry



We care much more about these things than whether your video looks professionally produced.



# HOW TO APPLY



Your application must contain:



**✓ Resume**



**✓ Introduction video**



**✓ Weekday or Weekend position preference**



**✓ Description of cleaning-service experience**



**✓ Description of customer-service experience**



**✓ Internet speed**



**✓ Computer/laptop specifications**



**✓ Confirmation that you have a headset**



**✓ Confirmation that you have a quiet workspace**



**✓ Confirmation that you can work 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time**



**✓ Confirmation that you are available to begin promptly**



# APPLICATION TITLE



Use exactly one of the following:



**NYC MAID RECEPTIONIST – WEEKDAY**



or



**NYC MAID RECEPTIONIST – WEEKEND**



This is also an attention-to-detail test.



If you can't follow the application instructions, this probably isn't the right position for you.



# WHO WILL SUCCEED HERE?



You'll probably do very well here if you're someone who:



- Shows up

- Shows up on time

- Communicates clearly

- Likes helping customers

- Thinks independently

- Doesn't panic when something goes wrong

- Takes ownership

- Learns quickly

- Likes technology

- Understands service businesses

- Wants responsibility

- Wants to make more money as you become more valuable

- Notices opportunities

- Suggests improvements

- Wants to grow with a company



We aren't looking for someone who simply wants to clock in and wait for instructions.



We're looking for someone who eventually understands the operation well enough that management can trust them to **handle business**.



If that's you, send us your video.



**We're hiring now and are ready for the right people to start Monday.**

title: Supplier Negotiation Reviewer — QA an AI Negotiation Bot (Clothing Sourcing)
description:
We built an AI bot that negotiates with clothing suppliers on behalf of buyers. It handles the back-and-forth on price, MOQ, samples, and lead times. Your job: be the human quality check on every conversation.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Read live negotiation conversations between our bot and clothing suppliers

- Check the negotiation is on track: pricing, quantities, MOQ, samples, shipping terms, tone

- Fix or rewrite the bot's message when it's off, then approve the final version before it goes to the buyer

- Flag deals that are going sideways or need a human to step in

- Report the bot's mistakes so we can keep improving it



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Real experience negotiating with suppliers (Alibaba/1688, garment or apparel sourcing is a big plus)

- Excellent written English - you can instantly judge tone, clarity, and whether a message will land

- You know sourcing basics: unit price, MOQ, sampling, lead times, shipping terms

- Detail-oriented and responsive - conversations can't sit waiting for hours

- Comfortable with chat tools and simple dashboards



DETAILS

- Part-time to start (about 20 hrs/week), can grow into full-time as volume grows

- Most suppliers are in China - same timezone as the Philippines, so normal daytime hours work

- Paid hourly, rate based on experience



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the words FINAL CHECK so we know you read this. Then briefly describe one supplier negotiation you personally handled: the product, what you negotiated, and the result.

title: Digital Marketing Specialist – Meta Ads, GoHighLevel & AI Automations
description:
Digital Marketing Specialist – Meta Ads, GoHighLevel & AI Automations



Remote | Full-Time | Long-Term Opportunity



Evolved Agents is hiring a Digital Marketing Specialist to join our growing team and help fulfill for clients inside our AI Marketing Academy program.



We’re looking for someone who is both technically strong and great with people.



You’ll work directly with new clients to onboard them, build their marketing systems, launch their campaigns, and manage everything on an ongoing basis.



This is not just a media buying role. You’ll help own the entire client setup from ads → funnels → CRM → automations → optimization.



** How to Apply – Required **



You MUST complete the application form below to be considered for this position:






Applications submitted directly through OnlineJobs.ph or through DMs will NOT be reviewed.



If you are interested in this position, please apply using the Google Form above.



– About Us –



Evolved Agents is a multiple seven-figure digital marketing company specializing in lead generation, AI, automation, and online business.



Through AI Marketing Academy, we help entrepreneurs start and scale their own AI-powered marketing agencies.



We’re a small, fast-moving team of A-players, and we’re looking for another rock star who wants to grow with us long-term.



– What You'll Do –



Client Onboarding



* Conduct 30–60 minute onboarding calls with new clients

* Welcome clients and clearly explain the setup and launch process

* Gather everything needed to build their campaigns

* Communicate professionally with clients throughout the process



Build Marketing Systems



* Build and launch Meta Ads campaigns

* Create static, video, and AI-generated ad creatives

* Build funnels and landing pages

* Set up client accounts inside GoHighLevel

* Build CRM pipelines, workflows, SMS/email automations, calendars, and integrations

* Connect third-party software using tools such as Zapier



Ongoing Management



* Monitor and optimize Meta campaigns

* Troubleshoot funnels, CRM systems, and automations

* Improve campaigns based on performance

* Maintain client accounts and ensure everything continues running smoothly

* Work closely with the rest of our team to deliver an excellent client experience



– Who We're Looking For –



You should be:



* Experienced with digital marketing and paid advertising

* Comfortable working directly with clients

* A strong English communicator

* Highly organized and detail-oriented

* Resourceful and able to solve problems independently

* Comfortable learning new software and AI tools

* Reliable and accountable

* A team player who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment

* Looking for a serious, long-term position with room to grow



– Required Experience –



Strong hands-on experience with:



* Meta Ads

* GoHighLevel

* Funnels / landing pages

title: Construction Estimator / Drawing Reader - US Commercial Projects (Project-Based, Can Become Full-Time)
description:
# Construction Estimator / Drawing Reader - US Commercial Projects (Project-Based, Can Become Full-Time)



**RULE #1: READ THIS ENTIRE POST BEFORE YOU APPLY.** There are three rules in this post. Rule #1 is right here. Rules #2 and #3 are further down. Applications that skip them will be deleted without a reply.



---



## About Us



On Site Contracting is a commercial general contractor in the United States (Ohio, Pennsylvania, West Virginia). We build ground-ups and fit-outs for business owners - franchisees and independent operators. We operate as a "paper GC": we don't self-perform, we coordinate the best subcontractors on every trade. That means accurate takeoffs and fast, clean sub outreach are the backbone of our business.



## What You'll Be Doing



- Read and interpret US commercial construction drawings - architectural, structural, MEP - plus specs and detail sheets

- Do full callouts and takeoffs by trade (demo, framing, drywall, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, flooring, millwork, finishes, fire protection, etc.)

- Build clean scope sheets/bid packages for each trade so subs know exactly what they're pricing

- Contact potential subcontractors, send them the scope and drawings, and chase them until we have real numbers back

- Track incoming bids, level them side by side, and flag gaps, exclusions, and anything missing from the drawings

- Report findings back in a clear, organized format we can price a job from



## Immediate Work



We have **two commercial restaurant remodels inside a strip plaza** that need to be estimated and priced ASAP. This is your first assignment, and it starts this week. Move fast and accurately on these and there is a lot more behind them.



## Requirements

- **Hands-on experience reading drawings for projects located in the United States.** This is non-negotiable. US plan sets, US trade standards, US terminology.

- Proven experience doing callouts/takeoffs and soliciting pricing from subcontractors

- Comfortable
ing and calling US-based subs and following up until you get a number

- Strong written English

- Able to work US Eastern Time hours when needed for sub follow-up

- Bluebeam, PlanSwift, On-Screen Takeoff, or similar - tell us what you use

- Reliable internet and the ability to start immediately



## The Arrangement



- Starts as **project-based** work, beginning with the two restaurant remodels

- Strong performance turns this into a **full-time position within 60-90 days**

- Rate: $5-10 per hour based on experience. Higher end for project-based work; lower end if/when this converts to full-time. First assignment is likely about 20-30 hours this week.



---



## HOW TO APPLY - READ CAREFULLY



There are three rules. All three are mandatory. If you miss any one of them, you will not be considered.



**RULE #1 - Read this entire post from beginning to end before applying.**



**RULE #2 - You must send in a video with your application.** No video, no interview. A phone camera is fine. We are not judging your production quality.



**RULE #3 - In that video, you must do two things:**



1. **State all three rules out loud** - Rule #1, Rule #2, and Rule #3.

2. **Tell us the exact experience and specific projects you have worked on in the United States** that you believe apply to this role and will help us. Name the project types, the trades you took off, the software you used, and what you were responsible for. Be specific. "I have 5 years of estimating experience" tells us nothing.



Keep the video under 5 minutes.



HOW TO SEND THE VIDEO (required):

1. Record on your phone.

2. Upload to Loom, Google Drive (anyone-with-link), or YouTube (unlisted).

3. Paste the full https link in your OnlineJobs application message / cover letter. Do not attach a huge video file. Do not say "I can send the video later." No link = automatic delete.



Example of what to paste:

Video: [paste your Loom or Drive or YouTube unlisted link here]



## Deadline



**All applications must be in by Monday, September 14, 9:00 AM Eastern Time.**



We are interviewing Monday and Tuesday and starting work immediately this week. Do not apply if you cannot start right away.
